chapters.title: Chapter 3730: Crucible II
paragraphs: "Hoo...shit!"
Primarch Vaethrava nearly kneeled down from the pressure, complex emotions coursing through her as she turned to see Melodrass near her, ashen and looking at her in horror.
"What..."
She wanted to ask, but realized half of her vision and senses faded away right after.
"Ah?"
Her immense Complexity as a Primarch didn't even feel it.
But it seemed like the warning given by that unknown entity was not just a warning of words.
Because...at this moment, half of the body of Primarch Vaethrava was cut off cleanly, alongside her weavings and Complexity, as she didn't even feel when it happened!
It was a lesson and a warning, to not speak of some things that one had no reason to speak about!
In the Nullvein Gravewake Folds.
Endless.
Vast.
Distance...was not even something to consider here.
In the midst of the collapsed layers of death, probabilities, and life, the Infiniverse Wheel of Existence was floating serenely.
Inside of it.
Inside the True Frequency of Manadynamics.
An endless expanse of shimmering cerulean, where the very air pulses with liquid mana.
Vast currents of glowing energy drift like winds, illuminating floating isles and crystalline rivers suspended across countless Strings of Existence.

Towering within this radiant Frequency are massive Megalos Mountains spanning thousands of Omniverses wide, levitating peaks encrusted with mana gems humming with ancient chants that would be conducive to locating the True Source of Mana!

Sprouting amidst them are the Infiniverse Yggdrasil Mana Trees, their translucent leaves glowing with shifting trillions of runes, branches stretching infinitely as they wrapped around the Strings of Existence.
It looked like a stage of beauty, chaos, and limitless energy potential all in one as currently...it was empty.
Empty except for the visage of Noah whose body retained its terrifying form of Ember Eternum!

He was sitting on the topmost branch of a Yggdrasil Mana Tree as he turned his head towards a distant area, his gaze actually crossing the Folds to gaze where the Dead Wheel of Existence he came from still was.

There, his body of Ozymandias just felt the eruption of a chilling energy that shockingly nearly collapsed the weavings of a Primarch, with a deep voice that actually spread across the folds echoing out!
|Another false alarm...You, stop uttering the names of things you do not understand. I will let you off with a warning today so you can act as a warning to others.|
He heard these words too as after that, an impact that shockingly cut multiple Dead Frequencies of the Wheel of Existence echoed out!
Even the Dead Prime Frequency of the End was affected, Ozymandias being woken out of his epiphanies!
And all of that was a warning that a Primarch received for saying something she shouldn't have.
It was also a warning and word of caution for Noah, as once more, based on the Prophecy he just heard and what he just saw, the Nullvein Gravewake Folds continued to be an extremely dangerous place!
And he had to move carefully.
But now, he had time.
He could breathe.
And he did just that, as there were many things to take care of.
He waved his hands, and in the next moment, the figures of Ruination and the Infiniverse appeared beside him.
"Master."
Ruination called out lightly.
|Master.|
The Infiniverse Body buzzed with authority as she was currently experiencing a rapid advancement of Complexity as she began the construction of more and more True Frequencies!

The two came to sit beside him on the branch of one of the countless Yggdrasil Mana Trees as right after, the seas of blue mana around them began to distort as the figure of the Great Beyonder appeared.
In her glorious humanoid form.
At the moment she arrived, she looked at Noah with a sense of complexity, as she floated towards him and asked lightly:
"Is it done?"
As she confirmed what the state of the Wheel of Existence was, Noah gave her a light nod.
"Dead. Only ruin and death flow across the entire weavings of the Wheel."
She became silent at these words before she sighed and nodded.
And Noah looked at this complex being who had attained the state of a Resplendent Monad right before the breaking of the Wheel, as he voiced out to cheer her up.
"With every end is a new beginning, for you and many others."
With every end...was a beginning!

The Great Beyonder mulled over these words before she came to lock her eyes on him and the figures of Ruination and Infiniverse beside him, while asking, looking at the endless seas of blue all around them.
"And what does the new beginning here look like?"
She asked the right question as Noah smiled and, while waving his hand...

Near them, space began to flicker as more auras of True Source Entities bloomed, the figures of the Holder of the True Source of Asche, Arthur, alongside the Omnifather, the Stellar Weaver, and dozens of other surviving Legends of the Wheel of Existence all appeared here!

They looked at Noah and their surroundings with a sense of solemnity as the atmosphere of the True Frequency of Manadynamics they were in right now, or the True Frequency of Entropy they were in before, were unfathomably unique compared to anything they had seen before!
They gazed up towards Noah and those seated beside him.
They gave an acknowledgment to the Great Beyonder, who nodded back with a sense of familiarity.
And Noah looked at these Legends as his voice echoed out.
"We have left the weavings of the now Dead Wheel of Existence as you all are currently inside...another Wheel of Existence. One that I sit atop of as its Master."
BOOM!
His words were ecstatic and tyrannical to hear, but he spoke them calmly and continued:

"You can choose to stay under its shade or delve out into the Nullvein Gravewake Folds if you wish. But as of this moment, I plan to institute methods for the elevation of my own power and yours within this Wheel of Existence. Because I plan to delve back into the Folds within the next few weeks and seek retribution against the Hollow Concord of Nullity, to decimate their Resplendent Monads and Primarchs of Complexity and Purity. I have confidence in doing this, but you all...are not complex enough to do so."
BOOM!
His words were akin to a stifling hammer of truth smashing down, causing the Legends to feel tremors of shame as their weavings buzzed while they looked ahead!
Arthur, the Sea of Ash, was surrounded by swirling gray brilliance as he asked:

"We thank you for all you have done for the countless lifeforms within the Wheel and for what you have done for us. But what exactly would you do that would change our Complexity and yours so much in the span of weeks? Retribution like this may take millions of years..."
Noah almost scoffed when he heard millions of years.
He worked in days and weeks at most.
He looked at the Legends here as he spoke out grandly:

"The most straightforward method of elevating Complexity and Purity is the Existential Source Trials. A battering of your True Source again and again. I plan to take that concept and elevate it to something far grander, as the method to get you all to become Monads and Primarchs in the few weeks...will be through what I call the Infiniverse Crucible Raids."

chapters.title: Chapter 3731: Crucible III
paragraphs: Existential Source Trials.
One of the three sacred paths Noah could use to raise Complexity and Purity, and the one most entities clung to.
It was the classic Mechanic of Ascension: the Existential Source Trials. The other was Source Devouring Evolution, with its twin branches, Complexity Devouring and Purity Devouring.
But Noah had forged a third path entirely related to Dual Cultivation.
One he had developed alongside the Great Beyonder, weaving it from the remnants of old truths and impossible dreams.
What he planned now would lean heavily on the first method, with a taste of the second.
"The Infiniverse Crucible Raids?"

The Great Beyonder arched a brow, curiosity lighting her eyes. She was asking about the very method that would thrust multiple Harmonized Sourcebound Icons and two Resplendent Monads into the rank of Primarchs, within mere weeks.

Noah simply nodded. He stood from the branch of the Yggdrasil Mana Tree, the rivers of radiant mana flowing around him, curling in currents of emerald and sapphire light. He glided through them, stopping at a fixed point before extending his hand.
Space split.
A colorless portal brimming with Quintessence bloomed into existence, dazzling, vibrant, radiating a complexity that defied reason.
Noah's voice echoed through the silence.

"You now stand within a new Wheel of Existence. Before the First Breaking of the Wheel, our native one was already brimming with True Frequencies of Existence. It housed Resplendent Monads. A Primarch. All due to the presence of extraordinarily Pure and Complex True Sources, capable of rivaling, even surpassing, a Primarch."
His words hung in the air like scripture.
"You're standing in one of those Wheels now."
The gathered Legends exchanged wary glances. Hope. Dread. Awe.
"Let me show you," Noah whispered, gesturing to the portal. "This leads to the Infiniverse Crucible."
He smiled. The kind of smile that meant danger and promise all at once.
The Great Beyonder was the first to step forward. Her obsidian gown shimmered, jeweled with thousands of runes that pulsed with golden obsidian light. She vanished like a streak of living brilliance.

The others followed, one by one. The Holder of the True Source of Asche hesitated only to glance at the distant silhouettes of Ruination and the Infiniverse Body, silent watchers in the shape of wonders, before stepping through.
Only then did the two entities follow, slipping into the breach like shadows fading into dawn.
And what waited beyond...
It was not just a battlefield.
It was a realm of roaring wonder. Of endless death and rebirth.
A place alive with color and pressure and power.
The Infiniverse Crucible.
Green. Purple. Blue.
They gleamed with terrifying brilliance, forming the sacred trinity of Frequencies- Continuity, Entropy, and Manadynamics.
The sky was a canvas of madness.
Above, the shards and fragments of the True Frequency of Entropy shimmered in deep, regal violet, tendrils snaking like vipers through the void, unraveling permanence with every flicker.
Beneath that, green veins of the True Frequency of Continuity surged through the terrain and skies, holding together the fabric of existence with unshakable grace.
Endless. Unbreakable. Constant.
And woven through it all was the True Frequency of Manadynamics, an endless, electric ocean of shimmering blue. It surged through stones, stars, even breath itself.
At the heart of it all pulsed a massive infinity symbol, buzzing with green, purple, and blue light. Above it, a Forge mountain rose like a wondrous monument, overflowing with radiant loot-light.
That... was just the sky.
The ground was no less intense.

Infiniverse Megalos Mountains clawed up from the abyss like time-worn titans by the hundreds, wrapped in storms of memory and myth. Shattered Omniverses drifted among them by the thousands, corpses of creation bleeding violet energy that screamed like dying titans.
In their remains spun trillions of worlds, rich with mana, each gleaming cerulean-bright with danger and possibility.
And between it all, fields of Matter, Anti-Matter, and Dark Matter surged in luminous green storms, storms birthed by Continuity itself.
The entire domain pulsed.
Pressed down.
Challenged.
The very weight of this place demanded proof of one's right to exist. Every breath. Every step.
Even the strongest among them, Nascent Source-Bearers, Harmonized Sourcebound Icons, Resplendent Monads, found themselves stifled.
Crushed.
Humbled.
And still, the Crucible whispered...
Prove yourself. Or die.
HUUM!
Noah arrived in the center of it all, storms curling around him like reverence. He turned to face the others, to face the Omnifather.

"This is the Infiniverse Crucible," Noah said, his voice soft but carrying. "Within it lie some of the purest and most complex True Sources of Continuity, Entropy, and Manadynamics. Soon, others will descend. This...is where Primarchs will be born."
A declaration. A truth.
And the Omnifather, wrapped in the grandeur of Versality, narrowed his eyes and asked, careful and cold.
A single word.
But it carried the weight of wonders!
Noah's eyes gleamed gold. A wheel spun upon his chest. His form flickered.
How indeed!
In the next moment, he was above the Omnifather.
His hand swung down like a starbound hammer, releasing a blow laced with such devastating Complexity that even a Resplendent Monad would hesitate to face it.
He did it to a wounded, weakened Icon.
BOOM!
The Omnifather didn't even have time to scream.
The blast of Ember Eternum, a Transient Paradoxical Living True Source, ripped through him.
Every possible revival.
Every lingering memory.
Every hidden thread of survival.
Gone.
His True Source shattered.
His existence, erased.
True Death!
Unmistakable. Unforgivable.
Unfathomable.
A silence swept the Crucible.
Noah lowered his hand like nothing had happened.
No one spoke.
But every Legend present felt it.
Felt their True Sources tremble.
Because there had been no trick.
The Omnifather, truly, was dead.
Their gazes sharpened, growing with anger. Hardened. Questioned!
Why?
Why would he do this now? Why this?
"Why?" someone finally whispered.
Ash swirled around the Holder of Asche's True Source. He looked lost in his own thoughts!
Only one being didn't speak.
The Great Beyonder.
After her initial shock, she stood quietly.
Watching.
Because she knew something the others didn't.
Noah never acted without purpose.
So what connection did the death of the Omnifather have to their path toward becoming Primarchs?
She didn't know yet.
But she would find out soon!

chapters.title: Chapter 3732: Crucible IV
paragraphs: What had just occurred was almost too much to bear- one of the Legends had their Weavings decimated, granted True Death before their very eyes!
And no one understood why.
Arthur turned toward Noah, his voice sharp. "Why?"
Noah didn't speak right away. He simply raised his hand, pointing toward the sky.
Toward the havens that shimmered with fractured remnants of the True Frequencies of Entropy, Continuity, and Manadynamics.
TING!
From the heart of the massive infinity symbol, pulsing like a living vein in Existence, a scream tore through the air. And then something dropped from it.
Hurtling down.
Landing inches away from where the Omnifather had just perished!
BOOM!

A radiant lotus bloomed in that space, glowing a deep, verdant green as it pulsed with the force of Continuity. At its center, a battered, dazed Omnifather gasped for breath, clutching at his chest, hands frantically tracing the Weavings of his existence.
"This... You...! What?!"
He could barely get the words out.
His Weavings had truly died. He had felt the nothingness. Felt his soul unmake itself.
And yet, after what could have been seconds, or centuries, he was back.
His True Source, once torn apart, was restored.
No, more than restored. It pulsed with newfound complexity. With purity.
Arthur stepped back. The other Legends stood frozen, eyes wide with shock.
Even the Great Beyonder, who rarely questioned Noah, was watching him now, something bright and knowing glowing in her eyes.
"You killed him... truly killed him. And yet, he returned, stronger, more complex and pure?"
She said it as if hoping to understand, needing confirmation.

Noah smiled faintly and pointed at her. "Exactly. The Infiniverse Crucible is a unique region in this Wheel of Existence. Anyone who steps into it has their signature marked. Anyone who dies within its bounds... will face True Death. The real kind. No illusions. No shortcuts."
Silence stretched around them.
"But," he continued, "after death, their Weavings are reborn, through Continuity, powered by infinite Mana."
A pause. Weighted. Sharp.

"In this place, you will be battered. Torn apart. Your True Source will either evolve, become more complex and pure, or you will die again. And again. That sensation?" Noah looked toward the Omnifather. "It's not pleasant. He can tell you."
All eyes turned.
The Omnifather scowled, fury and residual terror clashing in his expression. His now-empowered Source burned like wildfire.
"You... You were in my Tresoverse Primaltree, you benefited from my weav-...!"
Noah's figure flickered, an impossible blur.
He was beside the Omnifather before the sentence finished, fingers lightly pressed forward.
And with a calm grace, he struck.
Ember Eternum blared.
The force that even Primarchs could not hold down. It unraveled every possibility the Omnifather held, every thread of survival was extinguished in a breath.
His body shattered again.
Gone.
Noah exhaled.
And said softly, "Infiniverse Crucible Raids."
HUUM.
"I, the True Severed Origin Osmontian will be your Raid Boss."
Even the Great Beyonder flinched.
Noah's Weavings now radiated with dominance.

"If you can't withstand me, you will die. And in here, True Death awaits. But Continuity won't let you stay dead. You'll return, your Weavings reborn. Infused with Entropy, Manadynamics, and the gentle cruelty of Continuity."
He tilted his head. "Dying, over and over, is its own kind of power. Just ask the Omnifather."
TING!
"AHHH!"
Another cry tore the air as the Omnifather fell again, his Weavings cascading down into the lotus of green. His body unraveled and bloomed anew.
"See?" Noah's voice was quiet now. "It's not pleasant."
When the Omnifather returned a second time, he didn't speak. He just backed away, breath ragged, hands shaking as he touched his newly reforged Weavings.
More complex. Stronger.
But the pain... unforgettable.
Noah smiled, turning to the Legends.

"The Crucible, this design born of me and the Infiniverse, is uniquely bound to the core True Sources. Death is real here. Ninety-nine percent of your Weavings will be destroyed. Only the last one percent clings to life, held by Continuity, fueled by Manadynamics. Entropy ensures it feels like a complete death."
And every death? Every revival?
Rewrites everything!
Infused with new threads of Entropy. Of Continuity. Of Manadynamics!
Noah looked over each of them.
"By the time you survive me, you'll be Primarchs of Complexity and Purity. But until then, I hope the Legends of the Wheel are ready to die. Many, many times."
Silence thickened.
Then they stepped back. Tension rippling through them.
But Noah only smiled, radiant and cruel.
"To be fair," he said softly, "I'll abide by the same rules. The True Raid Bosses, Infiniverse and Ruination, will hunt me too. No holding back."
WAA!
He turned toward her.
The Infiniverse.

She shimmered with a thousand colors. Her very form birthed new True Frequencies of Existence every passing moment-each more chaotic, more beautiful, more dangerous than the last as her Complexity and Purity surged constantly.
She met his gaze, light blazing.
|Are you certain, Master?|
Her voice rang out, not from lips, but from the very fabric of the Crucible.
Noah gave a slight nod.
Every clash. Every test. Every bit of strain against his True Sources would forge him stronger and allow him to be more in line with his True Sources.
And Ruination? She had grown, but still couldn't match him. They both held forged Wheels, and she was still less complex than him currently.
But the Infiniverse...held access to multiple True Sources, and then her sheer weight and complexity as a Living Wheel was added on top of it!
He drew a deep breath.
"Don't hold back."
HUUM!
The Crucible trembled.
The Infiniverse's form surged with Complexity. A white mask bloomed over her face, veiling her eyes.
As if she couldn't bear for her master to see her as she tore him apart.
|Ember Eternum is transient.|
WAA!
|And when it fades... I hope Master is still alive.|
Her voice was steel now. Cold. Ready.
Noah turned back toward the Legends.
His True Sources snapped loose like coiled serpents, lunging into the air with murderous grace.
Legends scattered.
And so, it began.
The Infiniverse Crucible, domain of infinite deaths and rebirth, unfolded in full.
And elsewhere...
Outside this hellish battlefield...
Within the True Frequency of Entropy...
Another version of Noah sat still, suspended in a sea of endless purple, waves of decay and unraveling life lapping around him.
Across from him sat his son.
Henry. Kneeling on the still waters of entropy. Watching his father in reverent silence.
At that moment, something else stirred.
Not a True Source.
But a part of Noah all the same, his lineage.
And it began to burn.
To evolve.
Its Complexity and Purity rising toward something beyond imagining!

TING!

BOOM!

No illusions.

Weighted.
Sharp.

Ember Eternum blared.

Gone.

But Continuity won't let you stay dead.
You'll return, your Weavings reborn.

"Dying, over and over, is its own kind of power.
Just ask the Omnifather."

chapters.title: Chapter 3733: Unquestionably True! I
paragraphs: "My son."
Noah began, his voice serene, though his blood burned like wildfire beneath his skin.
The True Severed Origin Osmontian.
In this moment, he wasn't merely Truly Severed. He was more. So much more.

Bloodlines were peculiar things- basic in that they were universal, and yet sacred in how they carried weight beyond comprehension. Everyone had one. Everyone came from somewhere. But not everyone understood what it meant to carry the memories, the grandeur, the weight of generations within their veins.
And the way they were passed down... was just as unique.

Noah's bloodline stemmed from his mother and father. Humans, by all accounts. Their ancestors walked the same blue planet generations before. His grandfather and grandmother- he could glimpse pieces of them, scattered through the memories of his mother and himself. To them, the lineage meant little.
But to him?
To him, it meant everything.
HUUM!
Existence itself trembled.

His genome, the intricate genetic code that pulsed through his body and was passed on through him, had long since transcended the natural order. It had crossed thresholds of complexity again and again, until it became something entirely unfathomable.
From those crossings, a title was born: True Severed Origin Osmontian.

And now, now it evolved again- its Complexity and Purity surpassing even what a Nascent Source-Bearer Complexity Entity could dream of. It unshackled its former self and became something even more... Quintessential.
Noah turned his gaze to his son- those eyes full of reverence, of longing. Of the need to prove himself.
He saw the ache in them. The ache to be seen. To be worthy.
To bear the name Osmont with pride. To make him proud.
But at the end of the day...
He just wanted his son to be happy.
So he spoke, softly, with fire in his heart.
"My son... blood is not something just handed down. Blood is what you make of it. Our bloodline is one that exceeds. One that overcomes. But most of all, it is what we shape it into."
His words carried weight.
And with them, his blood responded.
For a moment, every vein, every artery- every channel of existence that carried his blood shimmered. His Heart of Infinity blazed with wild hues, a burning, radiant engine that defied understanding.
His blood burned with colors unspoken, its complexity and purity rising- rising until the very pressure of it could suppress Harmonized Sourcebound Icons.
It pulsed through him, and he met his son's gaze again- really met it.
Those eyes, still seeking affirmation. Still hoping.

"A bloodline is what you make of it," he repeated, voice resolute. "The True Severed Origin Osmontian bloodline is what I made of mine. One day, you'll decide what you'll make of yours. Even inherited destiny is shaped by effort and yours to freely take and enjoy.."
He wasn't the kind of father to withhold fortune, to teach through absence or deprivation.
No.
He was the kind of father who would give everything.
Because he had been raised by someone who gave him nothing.
And he would never be that man.

"Today, my bloodline will take a step forward," he declared. "And it will carry you with it. You, my son. And all who've stood beside me. This is my lesson to you- never be afraid to give more than you have. Because if you keep everything to yourself... it's lonely at the top. You may reach everything. And still have no one to share it with. So give, my son. And give freely."
BOOM!
The moment the words left his lips, the world shifted.
|The True Severed Origin Osmontian Lineage has undergone a True Existential Source Evolution, becoming the True Origin Osmontian Paracausal Lineage.|

|You have been deemed the Origin Prime Osmontian Infinitum. You forsook all personal gain from your lineage's evolution, allowing its wonders to be shared with those close to you and those who aided your Record.|
|A selfless act in the face of overwhelming Complexity and Purity.|

|And in turn, a paradox: You received not nothing, but a boon beyond comprehension. As the Origin Prime Osmontian Infinitum, The Complexity and Purity of all your weavings of existence now progress at a rate that cannot be quantified. It is simply... Paradoxical.|

|Your Progeny and close familial ties now fall under the First Tier below you, known as the Paracausal Infinitum Veinbearers. They may freely inherit Complexity and Purity at the Moderate Level from any True Source under the Osmontian Infinitum.|

|Those entangled in your journey, and those who supported your Record's evolution, are granted the Second Tier title: Paracausal Infinitum Oathbearers. They inherit Complexity and Purity at the Low Level from select True Sources of their choosing.|
|And the countless entities who channel through you... are now Paracausal Infinitum Echoes. If they seek growth, they may follow their own path to a True Source at a rapid rate.|
The prompts were endless. The impact? Even grander.
Noah had intended to give- but in return, he had been given something beyond fantastical.
A Paradoxical progression rate.
And already, he could feel its influence.

Another of his bodies surged forward- battling Infiniverse and Ruination, pressing against their every strike with no restraint. And behind it all, his True Sources spiraled outward, obliterating the Legends of the native Wheel of Existence.
He could feel the difference now.
Feel how his Complexity and Purity spiked with every breath, every strike, every intention.
If the numbers could be seen, they would have shot into the skies gloriously.
Because now, he wasn't just utilizing his Sources.
He was putting pressure on them. Bending their meanings. Denying others their truth and forcing new ones to take shape.
Utilization.
That would be key to everything moving forward.

True Sources were like celestial ore, tempered by glorious tempests. Every strike shattered weakness. Every thunderous blow forged deeper meaning. And every time it was reforged, it became more radiant- more intricate, until it shone with a complexity that rivaled even the deepest wonders of the Nullvein Gravewake Folds.
And now, Noah had gained wings to fly further than ever before.
His entire body radiated waves of terrifying immensity as his form gradually became ever pristine.
And around his body...celestial blue gold shimmering clouds filled with infinity symbols began to form!

chapters.title: Chapter 3734: Unquestionably True! II
paragraphs: In the violet sea of Entropy, where Noah sat with his son, his figure radiated majesty, wrapped in a semi-crescent ring of blue-gold clouds, swirling with regality and quiet tyranny.

Above him, a dazzling crown of stellar clouds bloomed into existence- trillions of runic, blue-gold infinity symbols floating in perfect synchronicity. It hovered above his head like it had always belonged there.

The stellar blue gold clouds pulsed with a symphony of light, each ring a song of glory. And Noah wasn't alone. His son sat beside him, his presence buzzing with growing immensity as the weavings of the First Tier of Noah's True Origin Osmontian Paracausal Lineage began to unfurl around him.
He was the foremost Paracausal Infinitum Veinbearer of all.
His Progeny.

Golden clouds, though slightly less intense, formed around Henry. A crown of golden infinity symbols- billions of them, spiraled into being above his head as his body trembled with newfound power. His Complexity and Purity surged in ways he couldn't have imagined just seconds ago.
He looked up at the glowing crown of starlit clouds, then turned his eyes to his father. There was something unspoken in his gaze.
His father had given him everything.
And all Henry wanted was...
"I just... I want to make you proud," he whispered, voice nearly lost in the sea of violet entropy. They were alone, yet the words came out small, uncertain.
Noah looked at his son, a small sense of sadness flickering in his expression as Henry continued, tears streaming down his cheeks.

"I want to matter. To show you I can be of use. To help you, not just as your son, but as someone who chooses to stand with you. But every time, you always feel just out of reach. Just a bit far. I just..."

Henry stood on the precipice of immense change. A choice of any of his father's True Sources was his to make. He could become a Harmonized Sourcebound Icon- an entity of staggering Complexity and Purity.
And yet, it wasn't power he spoke of.
It was love.
At that moment, Noah placed a hand on his son's shoulder.

"My own child matters more to me than anything else. For not telling you this sooner, I'm sorry. For never giving you the words you deserved, I'm sorry. You could speak the day you were born... and I never treated you like the child you were."

"I should have done better. And I will do better. I am endlessly proud of what you've accomplished- even with a father like me who steals the very weavings of existence and bends them toward himself. But pride... pride isn't the goal. Joy is. Freedom is. Love is. You are my son, and I will give you everything I never had."
He smiled, soft and filled with serenity.
His own father had given him nothing but life.
He would be better.

"Take your inheritance. Never fear anything from me. As long as you spend time with your mother, care for your grandmother, and treat your woman well—that is all I could ever ask of you. If you want more- combat, ascension, strength...there's a Crucible waiting for you. One you can enter the moment your Lineage's Complexity settles."
His words carried the weight of Omniverses.
And Henry, overwhelmed yet grounded, nodded.
He looked closely at his father one more time before he looked inward.
His mind danced with possibilities. He had once chosen Singed.
But now, he closed his eyes- and sensed the infinite threads his father had laid out before him.
And...
"Infinity," he said.
And the word changed everything.
A burst of endless blue brilliance exploded from Henry. Complexity and Purity surged from his core, ascending and swelling, devouring the limits that once bound him!
Noah watched with a proud, quiet smile.
He saw the transformation take place- what every entity faced when embracing a True Source. A rewriting of existence.
A realignment of Origin, Body, and Soul to Infinity itself for Henry.
So long as Henry continued to seek resonance with this Source, his Purity would rise.
So long as he explored its infinite faces, his Complexity would deepen.
And now Noah sought to make sense of it all- to give structure to the boundless.
To define power.
He looked at his son, watched as his power surged, and compared them to the Records—both of the Living and the Dead he had annihilated.
And slowly, as only the Weaver of Existence could, Noah wove a system to measure the immeasurable.
|The Quantification System of True Sources, known as the Source Quotient of Ascension (SQA), has been designed.|

|The Source Quotient of Ascension is a dual-value system that evaluates a being's mastery of a True Source using the Complexity Quotient (CQ) and the Purity Quotient (PQ). Each Quotient is measured in "Source Units (SU)," derived from progression rate, Source comprehension, alignment depth, existential structure manipulation, and resistance to Source Collapse.|
|CQ and PQ of a Nascent Source-Bearer: 100–999 SU|
|CQ and PQ of a Harmonized Sourcebound Icon: 1,000–9,999 SU|
|CQ of a Converged Architect: 10,000–99,999 SU | PQ: 1,000–99,999 SU|
|CQ and PQ of a Resplendent Monad: 10,000–99,999 SU|
|CQ and PQ of a Primarch: 100,000–999,999 SU|
A cascade of prompts flashed before Noah's eyes, systemizing the power of True Source entities.
His gaze sharpened. A blue panel filled with green light bloomed above Henry.
NAME: Henry Osmont
TITLE: Harmonized Sourcebound Icon
TRUE SOURCE: Infinity
STATUS: Complexity and Purity Surge in Progress
THREAT RATING: Green (Low)
Henry, only moments into his ascension, already showed quantified values that rose by the second. And Noah couldn't predict where they would settle.
As Henry closed his eyes and embraced the inheritance, Noah's attention shifted.

He turned toward the Infiniverse Crucible- his eyes locking onto the Great Beyonder, who was currently retreating as another of Noah's bodies unleashed trillions of fireballs upon her, each carrying the destructive elegance of the True Source of Singed.
A blue-green panel flickered into view.
NAME: The Great Beyonder
TITLE: Resplendent Monad
TRUE SOURCE: Runes
STATUS: Stable
THREAT RATING: Green (Low)
Noah's gaze moved again, this time to Arthur, the Sea of Ash.
NAME: Arthur, the Sea of Ash
TITLE: Resplendent Monad
TRUE SOURCE: Asche
STATUS: Stable
THREAT RATING: Green (Low)
His eyes gleamed with intensity.
He had begun to see Existence not just as a weaving of power- but as something he could measure, refine, and control.
Until, at last, his gaze turned inward.
To himself!

His father had given him everything.
And all Henry wanted was...
"I just...
I want to make you proud," he whispered, voice nearly lost in the sea of violet entropy.
They were alone, yet the words came out small, uncertain.
Noah looked at his son, a small sense of sadness flickering in his expression as Henry continued, tears streaming down his cheeks.
"I want to matter.
To show you I can be of use.
To help you, not just as your son, but as someone who chooses to stand with you.
But every time, you always feel just out of reach.
Just a bit far.
I just..."
Henry stood on the precipice of immense change.
A choice of any of his father's True Sources was his to make.
He could become a Harmonized Sourcebound Icon- an entity of staggering Complexity and Purity.
And yet, it wasn't power he spoke of.
It was love.
At that moment, Noah placed a hand on his son's shoulder.
"My own child matters more to me than anything else.
For not telling you this sooner, I'm sorry.
For never giving you the words you deserved, I'm sorry.
You could speak the day you were born... and I never treated you like the child you were."
"I should have done better.
And I will do better.
I am endlessly proud of what you've accomplished- even with a father like me who steals the very weavings of existence and bends them toward himself.
But pride... pride isn't the goal.
Joy is.
Freedom is.
Love is.
You are my son, and I will give you everything I never had."
He smiled, soft and filled with serenity.
His own father had given him nothing but life.
He would be better.
"Take your inheritance.
Never fear anything from me.
As long as you spend time with your mother, care for your grandmother, and treat your woman well—that is all I could ever ask of you.
If you want more- combat, ascension, strength...there's a Crucible waiting for you.
One you can enter the moment your Lineage's Complexity settles."
His words carried the weight of Omniverses.
And Henry, overwhelmed yet grounded, nodded.
He looked closely at his father one more time before he looked inward.
His mind danced with possibilities.
He had once chosen Singed.
But now, he closed his eyes- and sensed the infinite threads his father had laid out before him.
And...
"Infinity," he said.
And the word changed everything.
A burst of endless blue brilliance exploded from Henry.
Complexity and Purity surged from his core, ascending and swelling, devouring the limits that once bound him!
Noah watched with a proud, quiet smile.
He saw the transformation take place- what every entity faced when embracing a True Source.
A rewriting of existence.
A realignment of Origin, Body, and Soul to Infinity itself for Henry.
So long as Henry continued to seek resonance with this Source, his Purity would rise.
So long as he explored its infinite faces, his Complexity would deepen.
And now Noah sought to make sense of it all- to give structure to the boundless.
To define power.
He looked at his son, watched as his power surged, and compared them to the Records—both of the Living and the Dead he had annihilated.
And slowly, as only the Weaver of Existence could, Noah wove a system to measure the immeasurable.
|The Quantification System of True Sources, known as the Source Quotient of Ascension (SQA), has been designed.|
|The Source Quotient of Ascension is a dual-value system that evaluates a being's mastery of a True Source using the Complexity Quotient (CQ) and the Purity Quotient (PQ).
Each Quotient is measured in "Source Units (SU)," derived from progression rate, Source comprehension, alignment depth, existential structure manipulation, and resistance to Source Collapse.|
|CQ and PQ of a Nascent Source-Bearer: 100–999 SU|
|CQ and PQ of a Harmonized Sourcebound Icon: 1,000–9,999 SU|
|CQ of a Converged Architect: 10,000–99,999 SU | PQ: 1,000–99,999 SU|
|CQ and PQ of a Resplendent Monad: 10,000–99,999 SU|
|CQ and PQ of a Primarch: 100,000–999,999 SU|
A cascade of prompts flashed before Noah's eyes, systemizing the power of True Source entities.
His gaze sharpened.
A blue panel filled with green light bloomed above Henry.
NAME: Henry Osmont
TITLE: Harmonized Sourcebound Icon
TRUE SOURCE: Infinity
STATUS: Complexity and Purity Surge in Progress
THREAT RATING: Green (Low)
Henry, only moments into his ascension, already showed quantified values that rose by the second.
And Noah couldn't predict where they would settle.
As Henry closed his eyes and embraced the inheritance, Noah's attention shifted.

He turned toward the Infiniverse Crucible- his eyes locking onto the Great Beyonder, who was currently retreating as another of Noah's bodies unleashed trillions of fireballs upon her, each carrying the destructive elegance of the True Source of Singed.
A blue-green panel flickered into view.
NAME: The Great Beyonder
TITLE: Resplendent Monad
TRUE SOURCE: Runes
STATUS: Stable
THREAT RATING: Green (Low)
Noah's gaze moved again, this time to Arthur, the Sea of Ash.
NAME: Arthur, the Sea of Ash
TITLE: Resplendent Monad
TRUE SOURCE: Asche
STATUS: Stable
THREAT RATING: Green (Low)
His eyes gleamed with intensity.
He had begun to see Existence not just as a weaving of power- but as something he could measure, refine, and control.
Until, at last, his gaze turned inward.
To himself!

chapters.title: Chapter 3735: Unquestionably True! III
paragraphs: NAME: Noah Osmont
TITLE: Origin Prime Osmontian Infinitum | Resplendent Monad

TRUE SOURCE: Absolute Complex Atlas Living Wheel of Existence (Absolute Complex True Source), Singed, Infinity, Existence, Runes, Ruination, Manadynamics, Apocalypse, Cataclysm, Entropy, Protagonist, Life, Death, Paradox...
RATE OF PROGRESSION: Paradoxical
STATUS: Quintessential
THREAT RATING: Unquantifiable

The panel crafted beneath his title as the Weaver of Existence was deceptively small. But if he focused, truly focused, it unfolded like a boundless tome, an ever-expanding record chronicling every crevice of his being.
What he saw revealed the stark divide between himself and all others.
Thanks to his Living Wheel, his Complexity and Purity Quotients had long surpassed even that of the Holder of the True Source of Asche.
Now, all that remained was to harness his sources while enduring the unbearable strain of a terrifying Construct.
BOOM!
His thoughts shifted to her.
The woman whose very presence blended into the fabric of Existence itself.
The Infiniverse.
She had changed- utterly transformed.

Now she stood glorious and terrifying, adorned in a radiant battle bodysuit woven from fragments of the True Frequencies of Existence themselves. Rivers of verdant Continuity, violet Entropy, and glowing blue Manadynamics pulsed across her form like living veins of power. A white-gold mask hid her face, infinity symbols etched where her eyes should be- watching beyond all time and space. She didn't want her master to see her like this.
Not while she handed him a beating.
Her presence exuded Quintessence, Paradox, and a weight so vast that even Existence itself bowed around her.
And it wasn't an exaggeration.
To battle the Infiniverse wasn't to face one being.
It was to challenge a Living Wheel of Existence.
Every strike of hers bore the fury of a True Frequency- not just a skill, not a technique, but the embodied force of terrifying Complexity and Purity carved into form.

Continuity severed the start of Noah's Singed eruption before he even released it. Entropy corroded trillions of runes before they could be born. And Manadynamics... allowed her to shift between Frequencies in the blink of an eye.

Moments ago, golden sand had erupted from her as the allure of the True Source of Dreams bloomed, swallowing the battlefield in stellar sandy gold radiance—seeking to plunge every True Source into eternal slumber.
The distant Nascent Source-Bearer Complexity Legends had already succumbed, their True Sources slipping into an endless dream they would never wake from unless through death.
Fighting her felt like standing at the center of the Wheel of Existence itself, spinning faster than time.
Even his survival here... was far from certain.
He glanced at her status panel:
NAME: The Infiniverse
TITLE: Absolute Complex True Wheel | Embodiment of the Wheel
TRUE SOURCE: Continuity, Entropy, Manadynamics, Relativity, Dreams...
RATE OF PROGRESSION: Undefined
STATUS: Living Wheel Ascension
THREAT RATING: Undefined
Her Purity was immense.
Far beyond the reach of most others.
BOOM!
|Master, your focus isn't fully on me.|
The Infiniverse's voice echoed within him as Noah found himself surrounded- shattered fragments of four different True Frequencies floating around him.
Each fragment burned with Purity at Limited Absolute levels. Though it didn't reach Primarch status, its uniqueness made it impossible to endure.
And then...
|The Transient Paradoxical Living True Source of Ember Eternum has exceeded its limit and enters rest.|
|Your state of Paradox is both resting and not resting.|
|You may call upon Ember Eternum again in one hour. Its state may vary depending on which Fixed and Null Aspects are selected.|
The impenetrable shield around him vanished.
Ember Eternum faded, leaving only his core True Sources.
All around him, terrifying walls formed—fragments of Entropy, Continuity, Manadynamics, and Dreams crashing down from all directions.
And above him... appeared the one who had barely moved until now.
Ruination.
A living prophecy of collapse.

Her form shimmered in tight crimson-gold battle wraps- exotic, ancient, breathtaking. In her grasp, a massive crimson-gold scimitar pulsed with a ruinous aura. Its blade was etched with millions of tiny Ruined Wheels, each depicting a different Breaking of the Wheel.
She was the whisper of the end, again and again.
Her status panel flashed into being
NAME: Ruination
TITLE: Herald of the Final Collapse | Ruinous Wheel | Resplendent Monad
TRUE SOURCE: Ruination
RATE OF PROGRESSION: Undefined
STATUS: Ruin
THREAT RATING: Variable
She had poured every ounce of her Source into that devastating scimitar- artifact of collapse itself.
And Noah...he was cornered!
So he called out.
"Infinite Bloom."
HUUUM!
A boundless ocean of blue mana erupted from him.
And Ruination's figure multiplied.
The Fragments hurled down by the Infiniverse multiplied too, every attack stretched toward infinity as they began to pay the cost.
But unlike others... the Infiniverse and Ruination were tied to him.
They could tap into his Infinite Mana.
Which meant their weavings didn't diminish, they swelled.
Again. And again. Their attacks became even more catastrophic.
Even the scattered Legends watching paled- The Great Beyonder, Arthur, Resplendent Monads both.. stood horrified.
Because those layers upon layers of assault would destroy them many times over.
And yet Noah...Noah stood.
Floated!
Grand and Quintessential!
Arms wide as if embracing the storm.
As if he welcomed Death, and had allowed the emergence of Infinite Bloom so that it could happen!
BZZT!
All that power- every crashing fragment, every looming strike...paused mere inches from him an instant later.
Ruination panted, drawing her scimitar back and hundreds of her forms vanishing back into her being.
The countless fragments the Infiniverse had summoned froze... then withdrew.
The Infiniverse's mask shimmered, dazed.
Ruination's form trembled.
They both tried to speak.
And Noah...his eyes were sharp as blades.
"You can't bring yourselves to kill your Master? Not even while knowing it wouldn't be true death and complete collapse?"
At the very last instant... they couldn't do it.
The weavings of the Infiniverse and Ruination faltered.
Because even now, he was still their Master.
He understood them and why they did so.
It was akin to a human undergoing a surgery while they were awake, seeing their beating heart, and then taking a knife to stab it!
An unnatural action.
But for the sake of complexity and purity...
"Even I have to die."
HUUM!
"Everybody in this Crucible...has to die!"

chapters.title: Chapter 3736: Unquestionably True! IV
paragraphs: Noah's words were heavy, echoing through the dazzling waves of Complexity and Purity. Every gaze snapped to him, shocked, then in the next instant, the Infiniverse Body bowed.
|Forgive me, Master. It will not happen again.|
Nearby, Ruination bit her lip, her expression sharpening with fierce determination as she stared at her Master.
|I will bring you Ruin from the depths of the Cycles of Breakings, Master!|
They each spoke with unwavering conviction, and Noah simply nodded, lifting a hand to pause them.
The Infiniverse Crucible would now truly begin. Even for him.

He had crafted a method to quantify the very essence of a True Source, what it truly was, and how far removed it stood from Lesser, Greater, and even Prime Sources, and how they were nothing but roadmaps- guides to something unfathomably real and True.
There was still so much more to be done.
But for now...
HUUM!
His body began to shift.
Gold and blue clouds formed around him, regal and tyrannical in equal measure.
A stellar crown spun above his head, forged from those same celestial clouds, as his body radiated the terrifying majesty of the True Origin Osmontian Paracausal Lineage.
It was as if blue and gold auras poured endlessly from his very being.
His hair shimmered in dark blue-gold hues.
His eyes gleamed with golden pupils- spinning Wheels of Existence.
A blue-gold garment, etched in infinity runes, wrapped around his frame, hiding the powerful sculpture beneath.
He looked like something carved from Quintessential intention. So fantastically pure that it felt dangerous to stare at him too long as his mere presence could begin to unravel weaker True Sources.
He was the Origin Prime Osmontian Infinitum, and the grandeur of what that meant shone through.
It wasn't a True Source in itself, but a Lineage that held such staggering Complexity and Purity, it surpassed even Harmonized Sourcebound Icons, rapidly climbing to the level of a Resplendent Monad.
Blue-gold radiance swirled around him, and even if he made no effort to defend himself, a Resplendent Monad's True Source...could never reach him.
He could remain still. The Great Beyonder could attack. And yet, his Lineage's glow alone would deny her True Source of Runes any contact!
This... this was how variations of power revealed themselves.

Even without his Infiniverse Physiology, even without drawing on the Weight of the Infiniverse, Noah could lift a finger and cause a Harmonized Sourcebound Icon to collapse, or injure a Resplendent Monad with ease.
Pillars of Concordance? Irrelevant.
Mythic True Signatures? Powerless!
In the end, only Complexity Quotient and Purity Quotient mattered. Even a bloodline could distort existence, if strong enough, to deny True Sources entirely.
Noah stood on the edge of something profound, and he knew it with glorious tyranny.
Anything... everything... once it passed a certain threshold of Source Units, once its CQ and PQ reached true heights, could begin to alter Existence itself.
A Concept could do it.
A Ruined Wheel like Ruination could do it.
And now, even Noah's Lineage was doing it.
He could feel the applications unraveling in his mind.
Ruination, more than a weapon, had evolved past Source Values. She was a Resplendent Monad.
The Infiniverse, a small floating island, now bloomed into a budding Living Wheel of Existence, its Purity Quotient enough to stir envy in even the greatest Monads.
So many possibilities bloomed.
And all of this seemed geared towards him!
Others could not do this!
He could handle multiple True Sources, each with its own Source Units, its own Complexity and Purity.
Each of his individual True Sources held different Source Units.
Right now, the Living True Source of the Singed and the Living True Source of Infinity had the highest CQ and PQ values, carrying his overall metrics to staggering heights.
Now, his Lineage would add to it as well.
Most beings... they could only ever raise a single True Source. That was the extent of their existence's Source Units.
But Noah?
Noah was different.
Quintessential!
Theoretically, he could raise his Lineage's Quotients alone to surpass 100,000 PQ and CQ Source Units. Through this alone, he could wield the power of a Primarch.
Even becoming a Primarch...was impossibly hard!
Melodrass had tried. Noah wasn't sure if he stalled at 99,999 Source Units or somewhere just beneath it, but he hadn't been able to cross even that final point.
Noah, however...if he raised multiple aspects of himself to the very limits of the Resplendent Monad stage...
If his Lineage exceeded 90,000 SU... if multiple Living True Sources did the same... then he'd break past the ceiling without even trying.
That was who he was.
Unquestionably True.
Quintessentially True!
So many paths lay ahead of him, but now... he wanted to see what his Lineage alone could achieve.
If it faced the Infiniverse, Ruination, and all others...
If it were reforged and battered again and again...
Just how high could its CQ and PQ climb?
What Pillars of Concordance would emerge? What Mythic True Signature?
Would he even need those... or would his Lineage birth something greater?
HUUM!
A thousand ideas flickered through his mind in an instant.
And the Infiniverse Crucible trembled.
Space warped, then split, as Henry Osmont appeared moments later.
His gaze wandered, filled with awe, before bowing to his father.
And waited.
Because in the next breath...
WAP! WAP! WAP!
Light bloomed as distortions tore reality apart.
Queen Adelaide appeared, then Queen Barbatos, Athena, and other Queens of the Infiniverse.
Kazuhiko, the Emperor Penguin, the Blue Slime, the Kraken, Dr. Hall—dozens more followed, their auras blazing with Harmonized Sourcebound Icon Complexity.
They were the Paracausal Infinitum Veinbearers, those who had chosen a True Source from Noah, elevating themselves to this level.
But more arrived, radiating the gentler waves of Nascent Source-Bearers.
These were the Paracausal Infinitum Oathbearers, those who aided in Noah's Fables but weren't with him long enough to earn Veinbearer status.

Among them: Ayame, Erikson, the Bard of Quintessence, Lilith, the Weavings of Oppenheimer, of Old Man Eudemus, the Great Mother, the Observer of Old and Young, Little Aspasia, the Sages, Yoo Jin, Emeline of the First Flame, Mysara, and so many more.
Noah looked upon them as they emerged into the Crucible.
Even if billions appeared, the space would remain vast. The few hundred here were grains of sand against an endless sea.
But still... their numbers mattered.
And with that...his voice echoed out.

"Now, an endlessly chaotic Crucible will truly begin. Fight. Die. Live. Then fight again. Until your existence screams with Complexity and Purity. Here, there are no allies. If your friends care, they will try to kill you, because that is how we grow. Fight. Fight freely. Fight... for yourselves and all you stand for."
WAA!
The blue-gold crown above Noah spun as he gazed across the Crucible with glorious power.
This was just the beginning.
And now... he had to see just how far he could take things!
And elsewhere...
In the Nullvein Gravewake Folds.
WAP!

Silently, another one of his bodies materialized and faded while wrapped in paradoxical light, vanishing from sight the moment it appeared as no entity with less Purity and Complexity would be able to find him in the Nullvein Gravewake Folds.
He didn't intend to stray far.
Just enough to understand the region he found himself in.
To ensure nothing had been missed.
After all, for at least a week or two...
He had to remain low key.
And untouched!

So many paths lay ahead of him, but now... he wanted to see what his Lineage alone could achieve.
If it faced the Infiniverse, Ruination, and all others...
If it were reforged and battered again and again...
Just how high could its CQ and PQ climb?
What Pillars of Concordance would emerge?
What Mythic True Signature?
Would he even need those... or would his Lineage birth something greater?
HUUM!
A thousand ideas flickered through his mind in an instant.
And the Infiniverse Crucible trembled.
Space warped, then split, as Henry Osmont appeared moments later.
His gaze wandered, filled with awe, before bowing to his father.
And waited.
Because in the next breath...
WAP!
WAP!
WAP!
Light bloomed as distortions tore reality apart.
Queen Adelaide appeared, then Queen Barbatos, Athena, and other Queens of the Infiniverse.
Kazuhiko, the Emperor Penguin, the Blue Slime, the Kraken, Dr.
Hall—dozens more followed, their auras blazing with Harmonized Sourcebound Icon Complexity.
They were the Paracausal Infinitum Veinbearers, those who had chosen a True Source from Noah, elevating themselves to this level.
But more arrived, radiating the gentler waves of Nascent Source-Bearers.
These were the Paracausal Infinitum Oathbearers, those who aided in Noah's Fables but weren't with him long enough to earn Veinbearer status.

Among them: Ayame, Erikson, the Bard of Quintessence, Lilith, the Weavings of Oppenheimer, of Old Man Eudemus, the Great Mother, the Observer of Old and Young, Little Aspasia, the Sages, Yoo Jin, Emeline of the First Flame, Mysara, and so many more.
Noah looked upon them as they emerged into the Crucible.
Even if billions appeared, the space would remain vast.
The few hundred here were grains of sand against an endless sea.
But still... their numbers mattered.
And with that...his voice echoed out.
"Now, an endlessly chaotic Crucible will truly begin.
Fight.
Die.
Live.
Then fight again.
Until your existence screams with Complexity and Purity.
Here, there are no allies.
If your friends care, they will try to kill you, because that is how we grow.
Fight.
Fight freely.
Fight... for yourselves and all you stand for."
WAA!
The blue-gold crown above Noah spun as he gazed across the Crucible with glorious power.
This was just the beginning.
And now... he had to see just how far he could take things!
And elsewhere...
In the Nullvein Gravewake Folds.
WAP!

Silently, another one of his bodies materialized and faded while wrapped in paradoxical light, vanishing from sight the moment it appeared as no entity with less Purity and Complexity would be able to find him in the Nullvein Gravewake Folds.
He didn't intend to stray far.
Just enough to understand the region he found himself in.
To ensure nothing had been missed.
After all, for at least a week or two...
He had to remain low key.
And untouched!

chapters.title: Chapter 3737: Days of Quintessence I
paragraphs: The Folds were unlike anything else.
Not merely a domain to pass through, but a place that demanded reverence and fear.
The sheer weavings of the Nullvein Gravewake Folds required something beyond ordinary Source Units for any entity to maintain its existence within them.
That threshold?
One hundred.
The bare minimum for a being to be classified as a Nascent Source-Bearer. The base line for becoming a True Source Entity, or at least, possessing the level of Complexity necessary to mirror one.
Without it, the moment you stepped into the Folds, you would find your existence unraveled. Caught in an endless collapse of paradoxes, death, rebirth, and destruction all at once.
This was why most beings clung to the shelter of a Wheel of Existence.
But those who had transcended Sources, those who had become True Sources themselves, could break free from that tether- daring to explore the Gravewake Folds unshackled.
Even then...
"It seems that even Harmonized Sourcebound Icons could easily die in the Folds," Noah murmured.
He drifted through collapsed layers of existence- each strand broken, disorderly, and chaotic. There was no pattern. No law. Only paradox and silence. A place where Dead Things flourished.

Perhaps that's why entities from the Hollow Concord of Nullity were not worried about traversing this place. They traversed the Folds with ease while creeping toward the native Wheel of Existence Noah once called home.
The Folds favored them. And also...they favored him!
A faint blue and gold glow shimmered around Noah's body as a prompt appeared the moment he stepped in the Folds.
|Your Lineage carries a unique scent of collapse and death amidst its overabundance of life. You may traverse the Folds while expressing your Weavings of Existence at an unknown enhanced rate.|
He had the same immunity the Dead Things did.
Because a part of him, Ozymandias, was a paradox, a Dead Thing in form and truth.
So he walked freely.
And yet freedom didn't mean safety.

Every step came with risk. Sometimes, he would near a region and feel the sudden clamor of alarm bells in his mind. An instinctive pull, a warning that his existence could be unraveled or face a terrifying ordeal if he took just one step farther.
He heeded those warnings, veering away, uninterested in entanglements or disturbances as he mapped out the space around the anchored Infiniverse.
All around him, folds of collapsed obsidian existence. No signs of life. Not a whisper of motion.
And through it all, he never once called on a single True Source. Not even his Living Wheel of Existence.
He relied only on his Lineage.
A Lineage that shimmered blue and gold, radiating enough power that it alone allowed him to move through the Gravewake Folds.
And still...
With the True Source of the Protagonist withdrawn, hidden from Existence to avoid stirring unnecessary entanglements, he encountered nothing. No Dead Wheels. No Living ones.
Just... silence.
Deathly, paradoxical silence.

He passed through a zone where the weavings had collapsed so violently that stepping through instantly teleported him an unfathomable distance away. It took an entire hour, moving at blinding speed, to circle back to where the Infiniverse rested.
In one region, he saw layered clouds folding into each other, stretching for light-years. In another, slabs of solid obsidian formed land masses that spanned even farther.

Those slabs required phasing one's True Source through them just to cross. But that effort bled one's Weavings of Existence dry. If an entity lacked enough power to sustain the phasing, their body would congeal mid-crossing, and be crushed by the sheer pressure and stone surrounding them.
This was how dangerous the Gravewake Folds were.
Even Harmonized Sourcebound Icons could die by terrain alone.
And in another region, he saw liquified weavings of obsidian sludge that slithered like oily water, stretching endlessly.
The sludge was alive, in a way. It sought entry into the body. Through pores, through breath, through broken will. It desired to fill any being's Weavings of Existence with collapse.
If a True Source didn't have a high enough Complexity and Purity Quotient... it would die. Suffocated by paradox incarnate.
These were the Nullvein Gravewake Folds.
A place of collapsed truths.
Where death could happen at any time, anywhere!
And Noah walked through it for a full day.
One day.
It might seem like nothing to others.
But to Noah, it was weeks. Months.
A full day since the Infiniverse Wheel of Existence had undergone its Last Breaking.
BOOM!
In the Infiniverse Crucible.
"Huff... huff... huff..."
An Emperor Penguin panted, golden flames of the True Source of the Singed burning wildly around him.
Out of all the True Sources he could've claimed as a Paracausal Infinitum Veinbearer, Pride hadn't yet ascended to that tier with the other Seven Sins.
He'd asked his Master about this.
And his Master had told him- choose freely. If he truly wanted Pride, he could change it later when it became a True Source.
So he listened.
He chose the Singed. A temporary True Source, but glorious nonetheless.
And...
BOOM!
The Singed flames ruptured as Noah appeared, his fingers aglow with pulsing blue and gold.
Not a True Source.
Just his Lineage.
And that alone tore through the Singed's meaning like paper in a storm.
The Singed only held less than 10,000 Source Units. Barely Harmonized Sourcebound Icon tier.
Against Noah's Resplendent Monad-level Lineage?
BOOM!
Blue-gold tyranny descended.
The Emperor Penguin barely had time to scream.
"Wait, Mas—!"
BOOM!
Noah's hand, akin to a titan's wrath, smashed down and obliterated every strand of the Emperor Penguin's Weavings of Existence.
Then silence.
Noah turned his gaze across the battlefield, where a hundred of his bodies stood, crowned with incandescent blue-gold halos, cloaked in clouds of regal tyranny.
"Ahhh!"
A new scream echoed from the highest point of the Crucible as booming impacts echoed all around.

From a lotus petal blooming green with Continuity, the Emperor Penguin was reborn, remade even more complex than before. His eyes wide with terror, scanning the field to make sure none of Noah's bodies were near.
And then, he ran!
The Crucible surged with Weavings of True Sources, so many that others could hardly fathom the sight.
And among all of Noah's one hundred bodies?
Not a single one had died.
The opportunity once given to the Infiniverse and Ruination at the start? It had never returned!
Because now, when Noah focused solely on his Lineage's Complexity and Purity...
Even the Infiniverse couldn't undo him.
The truth was in the name.
True Origin Osmontian Paracausal Lineage.
The Origin Prime Osmontian Infinitum!

chapters.title: Chapter 3738: Days of Quintessence II
paragraphs: Other True Sources revealed abilities intimately tied to their nature.
Infinity birthed Infinite Bloom as a natural extension of its identity.
Paradox granted Noah the ability of Amalgamation, where he could be wholly fused with a True Source... and yet not.
The True Source of Existence could rewrite moments that had just unfolded through the mysterious Echoes of the Unwritten.
Ruination imprisoned Bob in an endless spiral of ruin and despair.
Every True Source had its own flavor. Its own defiance of the norm.
Then came Noah's Lineage.

As the Origin Prime Osmontian Infinitum, he could manifest the sheer weight of his Lineage's Complexity Quotient and Purity Quotient in ways unlike anything else. And the first ability he grasped was something he called...
Perpetual Infinitum Override.
By exerting even a fraction of his Lineage's influence, any Source-based ability that sought to target or bind Noah would simply... fail. Reality itself bent to his Paracausal framework.
It was elegantly simple.
Unless one's True Source was Paracausal, they could not harm him.
If fire tried to burn him, the moment it neared the blue-gold radiance of his Lineage, it would vanish, its heat stolen and its essence dissolved.
If Runes tried to engrave his skin, they would shatter before touching him, undone by pressure alone.
To so much as scratch him, a being would need to be Tyrannical, Quintessential, Protagonist, and laced with qualities of Infinity, just to align with his framework.
Only the Infiniverse Body came close.
Everyone else?

They were locked in a one-sided battle. Their True Sources fizzled into nothing the moment they neared him. And if they tried to defend themselves... he broke down their weavings as if they were paper beneath a storm.

There was only one other way to pierce his Perpetual Infinitum Override- a being needed a vastly higher Complexity and Purity Quotient. Something so overwhelmingly advanced that it could force its way through the override by sheer magnitude alone.
But even that wasn't the full extent of his power.
Beneath the surface of this ability was another, one he dubbed Weaver's Existential Synchronization.
It allowed him to instinctively understand, unravel, and refine any Source-based weaving he encountered.
In the past, he needed to drag defeated weavings into the Cradle of Purity to refine them and absorb what remained.
Now?
Now, the moment he laid eyes on a True Source's pattern... he could break it down, disrupt, and absorb it into himself. Instantly. Seamlessly.
A simplified, living version of the Cradle.
But to truly evolve, to meaningfully increase his Complexity and Purity, he had to refine something unique. Something greater. Something purer.
And that... was rare.
Of all the enemies his one hundred bodies faced, his own Paracausal Infinitum Veinbearers, the fading Legends of the collapsed Wheel...only two were of any worth.
One had devoured the core of a Broken Wheel.
And the other... was the Infiniverse.
And she... was maddening.
HUUM!
In front of one of his bodies, storms of Complexity and Purity raged, storms so dense they could shred a Resplendent Monad on contact.
The Infiniverse stood within them, adorned with multi-colored javelins rotating around her. But these weren't mere weapons.
They were Spokes.
True Frequencies manifested into form.
Her own evolved take on the Pillars of Concordance, personal, chaotic, stunning.
And Noah had to ask himself: Did he truly need to fight like a Harmonized Sourcebound Icon? Like a Resplendent Monad?
With their stifling reliance on Pillars and Mythic Signatures?
Or could he... be something else?
He remembered the feel of wielding an entire Frequency with his bare hands. The weight. The resonance.

The Infiniverse had taken that idea and spun it into reality. Around her, dozens of spear-like Frequencies rotated, glowing with unique colors, each capable of ripping through Resplendent Monads like paper.
She was terrifyingly radiant.
And then...
BOOM!
A detonation of prismatic force shattered the nearby Existence as the Javelins moved!
Noah body hurtled backward, slammed into a pillar of writhing blue-gold light. His fingers tightened, absorbing the damage into his lineage.
In front of him, she already hovered.
The Infiniverse.
A living conduit of collapse and rebirth. Dozens of javelins spun around her, rotating in patterns that defied logic, spokes of a wheel unseen.
Each javelin glowed with a unique color and resonance. Dreams. Genesis. Quantum. Prana. Helios. Continuity.
Every one held the weight of a True Source.
WHIIIRRR!
Five javelins screeched toward Noah a distance away, then bent the laws of existence and collapsed the distance to zero.
He didn't dodge.
He stepped forward.
The blue-gold halo of his Lineage pulsed, and three javelins vanished, consumed mid-flight, stripped of their integrity.
The fourth detonated against his shoulder.
BOOM!
It slowed him for half a heartbeat.
The fifth?
It stabbed through his side, leaking prana-infused essence.
And then, SNAP!
His lineage crushed it like glass.
The wound on his side sealed like it was never there.
The Infiniverse looked on coldly beneath her mask as her voice echoed out.
|Master, after all the True Frequencies I have formed, do you know where my Complexity and Purity now stand?|
She posed a grand question.
Only a single day had passed.
But for Noah, and those bound to him, a day was an eternity.
The Infiniverse had formed dozens of True Frequencies in that time, her growth accelerating to an impossible pace.
Noah smiled as her status panel appeared.
NAME: The Infiniverse
TITLE: Absolute Complex True Wheel | Embodiment of the Wheel
TRUE SOURCE: Continuity, Entropy, Manadynamics, Relativity, Dreams, Avalon, Genesis, Quantum, Prana, Helios...
RATE OF PROGRESSION: Undefined
STATUS: Living Wheel Ascension
THREAT RATING: Undefined
She was reaching the upper bounds of Resplendent Monads, faster than anything he'd ever witnessed.
And through her, he began to understand how Complexity and Purity were truly forged.
It wasn't a matter of summing up each True Source's values.
It was something else. Something deeper.
And he was still unraveling the sequence of how it all came together!
All the while, he studied her. Watched her surrounded by the spinning Spokes of the Wheel.
And he prepared.
Around him, blue-gold javelins formed, long, elegant triangles, each forged from his Paracausal Lineage. Each one ready to clash against the raw force of her Frequencies and what they stood for.
In the process of doing so, he was also gaining a deeper alignment of Continuity, Entropy, Manadynamics, and all the Frequencies she battered him with!
"I know where your Complexity and Purity stand..." he called out.
HUUM!
"Come on!"
He surged forward!
Beyond the Infiniverse Crucible, far from any battlefield.
His other body, traversing the Nullvein Gravewake Folds...came across something that wasn't just death or ruin after a day.
He was nearing the end of the liquified sludge of collapse, his Lineage's blue-gold glow keeping the paradoxes at bay.
And then... he saw it.
A landmass.
It didn't ripple with hostility.
It didn't scream danger.

Instead, it sat silently, a massive stretch of horizontal obsidian shaped like a Wheel. No Spokes jutted out. Instead, they were carved into its surface, etched deep into the obsidian like ancient scripture.
But that wasn't the shocking part.
The shocking part was what lived there.
Because yes, life dwelled there.
Noah saw figures, both Living and Dead, scattered across the landmass.
Above it, floating just meters off the ground were small metallic Wheels. Black. Obsidian. Some lodged into the soil. Others hovering, pulsing faintly.
And beyond this landmass? Round wheel like platforms, each another obsidian island filled with paradox, leading to an even grander expanse light-years away.
No conflict.
No Source surges.
Just... eerie peace.
Dead and Living Things coexisting, unmoving.
What the hell was this?
Just over a day after the collapse of his native Wheel, Noah had stumbled onto something entirely outside the Protagonist's pull.
It wasn't conflict. It wasn't an entanglement.
It was simply... there.
And it piqued his curiosity.
With no warning signs flaring in his mind, he drifted forward.
Intent on discovering what this land of silence and shadow truly was.
