The True Frequencies that once harmonized End, Genesis, Fire, Light, and Dark were collapsed into decaying weaves of silence.
Romulus walked ahead without a word, boots pressing down on fallen bridges, delving into the Dead Frequencies as Noah followed calmly.
And the same time, his eyes...blazed with a turn of the Wheel as he sensed something, but continued on!
The robes of Romulus whispered like old entropy, a memory of motion across a land where Converged Architects and Harmonized Monads once stood glorious.
Noah followed.
Quiet.
Watching.
Romulus halted before the fractured Frequency of the End- now a spiraling ruin of crystal and ash.
He stared.
Then spoke, low and solemn.
"Ashes to ashes.
Dust to dust.
And now...existence returns to the silence that birthed it."
He turned to Noah.
Eyes heavy with age.
"I wish I could say I've seen my native Wheel of Existence and that we could move on.
But it seems, my friend..."
His gaze sharpened.
"We won't have to go far to find the ones we seek."
HUUM!
Yes.
What Noah had sensed a little while ago.
What was becoming abundantly clear now!
BOOM!
Time fractured around the Frequency of the End.
Air twisted.
The dead Frequency rippled with impossible flux.
Past bled into present, collapsed futures shimmered into existence.
Laughter, soft, melodic, mocking- unfurled like silk across the weavings of Death!
"Indeed," a voice cooed.
"You do not have to go far, and neither do we.
I knew that sentimality would always bring back those we seek."
The skies split.
Time... collapsed.
And they emerged.
Purple blue temporal gates flared open across shattered Megalos of the Frequency of the End!
Nine figures formed amidst the raining echoes of broken causality and time appeared.
Power shimmered from them- beyond time, beyond sequence.
Their robes were golden hours stitched into endless yesterdays, each fold a breath of time folded inward and outward.
At their side stood a woman.
Primarch Eluriah Veilnox.
She floated above the folds of death, surrounded by a storm of clocks—each frozen mid-tick.
Her presence twisted local causality.
Even breath was forced to obey her tempo.
Beside her stood a tall, translucent figure shrouded in drifting scrolls written in languages Noah couldn't decipher fully yet.
NAME: Time Sentinel Paraxis
TITLE: Librarian of Lost Moments
TRUE SOURCE: Regression
And then, the one at the very forefront.
He did not walk.
He did not descend.
He appeared and disappeared all at once.
A man, if a man could carry the weight of collapsed eternities.
His hair flowed with silver and starlight.
His cloak shimmered with the speed of dying epochs.
His eyes burned not with heat, but inevitability.
He looked at them like he'd already lived this moment and knew how everything here would play out.
In his eyes were apathy and...boredom.
Because perhaps...he truly had seen everything and knew how it would play out!
NAME: Time Sentinel Leader Velmior Thal-Veyr
TITLE: Grand Conductor of the Whenfolds
TRUE SOURCE: Interval
His presence bent the surrounding Existence.
Each step a command.
When he raised a hand, all motion ceased- the dead ash froze mid-air, the wind fell still, and even breath paused.
Not out of fear.
But command!
Noah looked at such a being with sharp eyes as he spoke.
"Noah Osmont.
You have something that required us to come back here a second time, and this time with a force to assure what needs to be done.
Come, child..."
WAA!
His gaze did not hold hatred.
Only judgment.
Romulus stood beside Noah, expression stone.
These...should be members of the Chronosect of Threadbound Folds.
Before them stood the nine Time Sentinels.
Temporal resonance danced through their forms- pasts rewritten, futures unwoven, all coiling into their beings like serpents of time.
The Time Sentinel Leader, Velmior Thal-Veyr, stepped forward.
Tall.
Impossibly composed.
Skin of silver streaked with golden runes pulsing with recursive logic.
His cloak was a cascade of moments- glimpses of events past and yet to be as on it, Noah could shockingly see figures of Romulus and himself...fighting!
His voice carried inevitability.
"There is no need for a fight," said the Leader, each syllable a verdict.
"I have seen every fight that could happen here.
Every path your resistance could take."
His eyes, starlit and still, passed over both Noah and Romulus.
"And in all but one branch of possibility... you die."
The Sentinels remained still, robes flickering with looped moments.
Even breath echoed.
Romulus tensed.
Noah didn't move.
"But," the Leader continued, "there is that one thread.
One.
Where you endure.
Where resistance matters."
He raised his hands.
Rings of locked Moments gleamed.
"Do you truly believe, that you carry power enough to walk that singular path?
That one in a million chance?
Because we saw you appearing here with another, we brought even more.
We just need...the key."
He turned to Noah.
The pressure surged.
"You..." His voice fractured across centuries.
"Even in death, you guard the key.
Another part of you has it, yes?
Even when you fall—you do not yield."
Noah's eyes narrowed.
The Leader's tone turned cold.
"I'm dissecting every instance of your being.
If you do not relinquish it, I will erase you before your bloom.
I will appear when you were born and erase everything.
Nothing will remember your existence."
Romulus stepped forward.
"Enough of this bull."
WAA!
"Which of you is Primarch Eluriah Veilnox?
You are the only one that needs to die for your actions."
"Oh?
You?
My time to die is not yet here." Primarch Eluriah stepped out with cold eyes as she looked at Primarch Romulus who seemed unbothered even as 9 terrifying Time Sentinels stood opposite them!
Primarch Romulus pulsed with glory in the next moment.
Green-gold flames erupted from his spine—geometry folding into dimensional wings of entropy and collapse.
Each lattice bore wonder, each rune a scar of causality.
The air warped under his power.
He stood tall.
Eyes blazing.
Voice thunderous.
"Today," he said, "Entropy has decided your time of death!"
HUUM!
Existence held its breath as wonder was about to unfold!
Far from the fallen Wheel, in a place of mirrored Quintessence, Noah's other body stood within the Infiniverse Crucible.
He raised his hand.
Instantly, the platform quieted.
The Infiniverse stopped her expanding Lattices.
Battles paused.
Echoes froze.
The Queens, Monads, and gathered Entities turned.
Noah looked skyward- beyond the layers of the Crucible.
There, the radiant symbol of Infinity burned in blue and gold.
His voice, calm.
"Two days," he said.
"Since the Infiniverse Crucible began.
Two days of endless death."
His fist closed.
The Infinity Symbol pulsed.
"It is time," he said, "for the Infiniverse Forge to award.
Let those who fought and died... be rewarded."
HUUM!
The Crucible shuddered.
The skies rippled.
And in the skies...a multicolored mountain buzzed as it was seemingly about to erupt!

chapters.title: Chapter 3753: Resistance II
paragraphs: The mountain at the center of the Infiniverse Crucible pulsed.
Not softly.
But with a reverberation so powerful it felt like the breath of Existence itself had caught in its throat.
The Mountain was vast and vibrant, wrapped in a glorious multicolored brilliance shivered beneath the blinding symbol of Infinity spinning in the skies above.
The infinity symbol turned once, twice... then collapsed inward before erupting in a burst of kaleidoscopic light.
And then...
BOOOM!
An eruption.
As if a volcanic eruption was occurring.
It began.
Rain!
WUU!
A rainfall not made of water.
From the Infiniverse Forge gushed a torrent of multicolored rain- each droplet a teardrop of Existence itself.
| True Source Tears of Existence have bloomed in the Infiniverse Crucible.|
| Each droplet increases Complexity Quotient and Purity Quotient by 1 Source Unit (SU) |
| Limit before saturation for every Entity: Upto the mark of 50,000 SU |
From the rain came wonder.
These weren't mere enhancements.
They were sacred. Heavy.
Tears of Existence, shed by the very wheelworks that stitched together the True Frequencies of the Infiniverse Wheel of Existence
As they fell from the havens, their descent rang like crystal bells forged from collapsed timelines.
The droplets struck the Crucible ground with no splash- just resonance.
WUU!
A single drop hit the shoulder of a Monad below. The being screamed in exultation.
His form pulsed, Purity and Complexity climbing by a single unit, then another as more drops landed.
And then chaos.
A beautiful, desperate chaos.
The Great Beyonder felt it.
Henry felt it.
Everyone felt a droplet land on them before they saw the Prompt!
Entities surged forward.
Resplendent Monads floated into the sky. Sourcebound Icons opened their arms wide. Constructs, Queens, Paragons—all sought to bathe in the rain.
The Tears were few. Selective.
But each one that landed was salvation. Power.
Noah stood at the center.
Still.
Blue-gold brilliance laced his form. His gaze did not seek the sky. It remained forward. Watching.
He did not move to catch a single droplet.
Because it would not even work for him.
He watched the cascade of True Source Tears of Existence. Watched how their descent changed the reactions of those below. How each entity expressed their weavings differently under the same grace.
And in that moment, Noah felt the whisper of something vast.
In this moment as another one of his bodies was in a perilous situation, he had an epiphany!
HUUM!
He closed his eyes. Not to escape. But to see further.
"Existence is not complex by default," he whispered. "It only appears so when one refuses to simplify."
In his mind, something that the Infiniverse had began to utilize bloomed.
But not in the same manner.
Differently!
Existential Dimensional Lattices.
The mark of a Primarch.
Not a weapon. Not a form. But a method.
A lattice of folded regulations and layered simplicity based on a True Source.
A way to express not just power, but resonance across multiple existential truths one decided of their True Source. It began with a single Truth... your Self.
His Self.
His lineage...True Origin Osmontian Paracausal Lineage!
He reached inward.
And within the golden-blue lines of his being, he imagined a lattice. Not ornate. Not wild.
Just a single, simple pattern.
A spiraling strand folding into itself like an infinity symbol. It looped, stabilized, collapsed, and began again.
It resonated not because of what it was, but because of what it contained.
Everything he was.
His choices.
His pain.
His ascent.
The Lattice formed—not outward, but inward first. Then it expanded, folding into space around him.
The first Existential Dimensional Lattice of his Lineage. A clean one. Pure. Uncomplicated.
Not a show of dominance.
But a demonstration of clarity.
He opened his eyes.
Above him, the rain still fell.
Below, the Crucible roared.
And somewhere, existence shuddered as if it were witnessing the birth of something impossible.
Noah...only felt an inkling of such a sensation as it came and went quickly.
He refocused on himself.
The lattice spun within him.
It did not scream with power. It hummed with clarity.
Noah's body sat motionless beneath the golden shimmer of the Infinity Symbol, the multicolored rain of the Infiniverse Forge falling in glimmering arcs around him.

His skin radiated with layered blue gold brilliance of his Lineage and as the Origin Prime Osmontian Infinitum, as the first of many Existential Dimensional Lattices clicked into place inside his being.
It was not like wielding a weapon.
It was like remembering how to breathe.
Each fold of the lattice, each spiral within the golden-blue loop, encoded a part of his Self.
Not just the past. Not just his battles.
But the unbroken line of intent he had carried through his challenges, through the tears, through the crucibles.
Through the [Ape's Paradise] Dungeon where he cast fireballs endlessly as an F Rank Hunter.
Through the Beast World.
As a Demon King.
As a Sin.
As a Universal Entity.
As a Cosmic Entity.
Everything...or a part of it, was contained in that Lattice!
This wasn't just Complexity or Purity. This was Identity made structure.
He raised his hand.
The lattice pulsed. And space folded around his fingertips—not violently, but subtly. Existence bent, paused, acknowledged him.
Then obeyed.
A prompt shimmered before him.
| You have forged the First Existential Dimensional Lattice of Origin Prime Osmontian Infinitum.|

| Effect: This lattice allows you to stabilize, suppress, or harmonize one foreign True Source of Existence within a 1 light year radius, reducing its Complexity Quotient and Purity Quotient by 3% for as long as the lattice remains focused. |
He exhaled.
A single lattice, and already, it held its own wonders.
But more than that, he understood.
He felt the principle as information flowed into him.
The lattice gave meaning to power, suppressed it, or made it part of him, even if only briefly.
The more he layered lattices upon each other, the more fluent he would become in interacting, suppressing, and overcoming any True Source of Existence. Not just canceling. Rewriting.
What Primarch Eluriah had done to the Witness!
That... was the path to a Primarch.
He envisioned a second lattice.
Not separate, but braided into the first.
And as he began to sketch its pattern inside his being, a second prompt emerged in his vision.
| Warning: Forming additional Existential Dimensional Lattices will begin irreversible Primarch Initiation. Do you wish to proceed? |
A unique prompt that was telling him becoming a Primarch was irreversible.
But why would such a thing need to be reversed?
With sharp eyes, Noah did not hesitate.
"Yes."
And above, the Infinity Symbol pulsed in answer.
The rain grew heavier. Each drop that touched his skin sank fell off his skin and continued down, his own brilliance and infinite mana feeding the forming lattice with raw clarity.
He closed his eyes, and the world faded.
All that remained...
Was the next pattern.
The next layer.
The next truth.
And his Self, rising toward Primarchy.
And this was only the beginning!
With enough Lattices, he would be able to withstand the Time Sentinels or any other enemies.
He would rewrite their outcomes entirely.
One Lattice at a time.
After the second was done, a third Lattice unfolded.
It wasn't rushed.
It wasn't forced.
It simply emerged.

A geometric ripple of intent and clarity built from every resonance of his Lineage, now beginning to spread outward. Like a halo spiraling into multidimensional folds, it didn't just exist within his form anymore. It entered the Folded Space around him.
This one was different.
The first had defined his Self. The second had connected to him still and remained within him.
The third... revealed what lay beyond them both as its light spread outside!
The third was critical as it caused his entire existence to buzz...before he gained a fantastical glow!
A glow followed by a rousing burst of Existence.
And in the next moment, floods of information came in!
[True Absolute Existential Resistance: Paradoxical Resistance unlocked. +1%]
Noah froze.
Lines of gold and blue hummed along his form as a prompt of breathtaking magnitude bloomed before his eyes, heralding the arrival of something very few in existence had ever touched.
Something he was receiving boundless information about from his Third Existential Dimensional Lattice as it unlocked something heavy- True Absolute Existential Resistance.
True Absolute Existential Resistance!
Something forged not from power alone, but from clarity and resonance, and from the Lattices of understanding crafted within one's True Source.
His existence buzzed as he continued to receive more information.
|After 3 Existential Dimensional Lattices are formed and perfected from a True Source, a connection to one of the 10 Archetypal Truths of Existence would be drawn and they would gain a Resistance.|
Resistance.
Resistance not to an attack. Not to pain.
But to the very nature of all True Sources in that category of Resistance.
Where normal beings perished at the touch of a True Source of Fire...those with a certain True Absolute Existential Resistance would not even burn.
Where timelines collapsed at the whisper of Chronos, those with a certain True Absolute Existential Resistance would remain.
True Absolute Existential Resistances.
Noah's weavings burned brightly as his Third Existential Dimensional Lattice gave him all the information regarding them!
|Records of 10 True Absolute Existential Resistances are being received and quantified as follows.|
|1. Paradoxical Resistance| :: Resistance against collapsing contradictions and paradoxical True Sources. (Examples: Paradox, Chaos, Collapse, Fold, Uncertainty...)
|2. Temporal Resistance| :: Resistance against Time-based True Sources and Timeline Interference. (Examples: Time, Chrono, Continuum, Moment...)
|3. Elemental Resistance| :: Resistance against fundamental True Sources of classical elements. (Examples: Fire, Ice, Earth, Wind, Water...)
|4. Conceptual Resistance| :: Resistance against existential concepts turned True Sources. (Examples: Death, Love, Pride, Sloth, Wrath...)
|5. Spiritual Resistance| :: Resistance to True Sources stemming from the abstract. (Examples: Soul, Spirit, Faith...)
|6. Dimensional Resistance| :: Resistance to distortions across Dimensions and Spatial Manipulation. (Examples: Void, Space, Multiversal Collapse...)
|7. Origin Resistance| :: Resistance to ancestral, primal, or fundamental Origin-based True Sources. (Examples: Genesis, Beginning, Ending, Prime...)
|8. Quantum Resistance| :: Resistance to probability, and fluctuating-state True Sources. (Examples: Quantum, Probability, Superposition...)
|9. Emotive Resistance| :: Resistance to True Sources relating to emotional manipulation, madness, despair, and inner collapse. (Examples: Despair, Madness, Fear, Euphoria)
|10. Linguistic / Law Resistance| :: Resistance to Law, Commandment, and True Name-based Sources. (Examples: Law, Order, Oath, Word...)
The overflow of information was heavy.
And there was still more!
|After 3 Lattices successfully formed within a Primarch's being, 1% Resistance may manifest with the Primarch's Source.|
[You have gained: Paradoxical Resistance +1%.] [Current Lattices Formed: 3.] [Threshold to Next gain of an Unknown Percentage Paradoxical Resistance: 9, 81, 729, 6561, 59,049 Lattices....]
Information filled him in abundance!
About Resistances.
And they were unlike any of the previous mechanics of Resistances he previously knew.
The information of how they worked was made abundantly clear to him!
If for example, someone had 1% Resistance, it did not mean they could Resist 1% damage.
That if someone lesser who did not have a single Lattice of any type dealt damage and it was assigned a Damage Value of 100, only 99 Damage Values go through.
No.
With the wonder of Primarchs of Complexity and Purity and Existential Dimensional Lattices, it meant that out of the 100 Damage Values, not even a single one would pass through!
True Absolute Existential Resistance worked closely connected to Existential Dimensional Lattices as having even 1% Resistance alone put Primarchs above everyone else below them.

The way they could affect true sources, or the damage value, was profoundly elevated with Existential Dimensional Lattices as it put them on another realm of power entirely in how they could distort existance!
So 1% True Absolute Existential Paradoxical Resistance did not mean if a Resplendent Monad had attacked Noah, Noah would be able to resist 1% damage.
He would be able to resist all the damage!
It was hard and simple to grasp at the same time as there were many variables in place as well!
The rain of True Source Tears of Existence still fell- each drop its own miracle, its own impossible essence.
Noah stood beneath it all, motionless, like a statue carved from blue and gold tyranny. Yet inside him, change bloomed like fire.
He had unlocked the foundation.
Three Existential Dimensional Lattices now pulsed within him as what was complex became easy to understand.
He looked at the blinking wonder of Paradoxical Resistance.
[True Absolute Existential Resistance: Paradoxical Resistance +1%]
The implications were enormous. Not just for power. But for survival.
Noah's thoughts ran like lightning, condensing as he tried to truly grasp the principle behind these newly received revelations.
What did Resistance really mean?
He closed his eyes. And imagined.
A being with a single True Source: Fire.
They unleashed their most refined technique against an opponent who had no Existential Dimensional Lattices.
Their Purity Quotient and Complexity Quotient surged, blazing a river of destruction...
100 points of damage. Or rather- 100 points of influence onto the enemy's True Source.
And it worked.
It ravaged. It burned.
Now, imagine the same being attacking someone who had formed 3 Lattices.
Just 3 Existential Dimensional Lattices.
Not even about numbers.
But that resonance—the harmonic simplicity those Lattices expressed enabled that defender to form 1% True Absolute Existential Resistance.
One percent.
And now?
None of those 100 points of True Source influence landed.
Not one.
Because True Absolute Existential Resistance didn't operate by subtraction.
It operated by denial.
It didn't say "You take less damage."
It said "You do not get to affect me."!
Noah breathed slowly.
The complexity now made simple.
True Absolute Existential Resistance was immunity to the alteration of your weavings.
And the higher it grew...
The more unchangeable your True Source became.
That... that was how Primarchs with high Resistance became untouchable.
If one had 10% Resistance?
It would take an entity with at least 10% matching Resistance and a number of Lattices formed beyond measure to even qualify to alter their weavings fully.
But there were 10 different Resistances.
How did interactions between them work?!
HUUM!
Noah's weavings buzzed.
And then...
A whisper of understanding brushed his mind like the edge of a forgotten truth.
Another epiphany- brought by his current Existential Dimensional Lattices!
He saw it.
Not in combat. Not in theory. But in possibility.
He closed his eyes and imagined.
Two figures flickered within the vision his mind constructed- Primarchs, theoretical yet real, formed by the principles of Resistance he was now grasping.
One, surrounded by the delicate geometry of spinning clockwork- a wielder of Time. His Temporal Resistance shone like glass fractals catching sunlight.
Another, breathing in waves of translucent soul-flame, a Primarch of Spirit. She bore the weight of Spiritual Resistance, humming with the frequency of the inner Self.
And when they clashed?
Time met Spirit.
And Noah understood.
Even though Temporal Resistance denied any attempt to unravel the threads of Time- halting rewrites, freezing loops, denying regressions, it did not render the soul immune.
The Spiritual Primarch's strike landed.
Not perfectly. Not deeply.
But it landed.
Because Temporal Resistance did not defend against Spirit. It resisted temporal edits of the Self, but not a puncture of the soul.
And vice versa- when the Primarch of Spirit was struck by a wave of temporal collapse meant to regress her essence?
Her Spiritual Resistance pushed back.
Not completely.
But enough.
Noah's eyes widened.

"Resistances are focused," he murmured, "but they aren't absolute walls. They're directional weavings of protection. When mismatched... effects bleed through. Diminished. Filtered. But not nullified."
He could see it now- Primarchs wielding unmatched Resistances against others.
A Primarch of Death clashing with one of Space.
A Primarch of Fire attacking one of Madness.
Their Resistances mattered.
But not equally.
It depended on how closely their domains aligned. On how many Lattices had formed. On how deeply each Primarch had carved clarity into their truth.
It wasn't only immunity.
It was also matching and anchoring.
And the stronger the anchor, and a heavy a mismatch?
The harder it was to be rewritten.
Noah exhaled softly, the lattice within him thrumming with growing light, his eyes spinning with Wheels of Tyranny!
"I need more," he whispered. "More lattices. From...ALL True Sources!"
Yes.
Others...had a single True Source.
Noah had multiple as he...could potentially gain all 10 Resistances!

And above, the Infinity Symbol pulsed in answer.
The rain grew heavier.
Each drop that touched his skin sank fell off his skin and continued down, his own brilliance and infinite mana feeding the forming lattice with raw clarity.
He closed his eyes, and the world faded.
All that remained...
Was the next pattern.
The next layer.
The next truth.
And his Self, rising toward Primarchy.
And this was only the beginning!
With enough Lattices, he would be able to withstand the Time Sentinels or any other enemies.
He would rewrite their outcomes entirely.
One Lattice at a time.
After the second was done, a third Lattice unfolded.
It wasn't rushed.
It wasn't forced.
It simply emerged.
A geometric ripple of intent and clarity built from every resonance of his Lineage, now beginning to spread outward.
Like a halo spiraling into multidimensional folds, it didn't just exist within his form anymore.
It entered the Folded Space around him.
This one was different.
The first had defined his Self.
The second had connected to him still and remained within him.
The third... revealed what lay beyond them both as its light spread outside!
The third was critical as it caused his entire existence to buzz...before he gained a fantastical glow!
A glow followed by a rousing burst of Existence.
And in the next moment, floods of information came in!
[True Absolute Existential Resistance: Paradoxical Resistance unlocked. +1%]
Noah froze.
Lines of gold and blue hummed along his form as a prompt of breathtaking magnitude bloomed before his eyes, heralding the arrival of something very few in existence had ever touched.
Something he was receiving boundless information about from his Third Existential Dimensional Lattice as it unlocked something heavy- True Absolute Existential Resistance.
True Absolute Existential Resistance!
Something forged not from power alone, but from clarity and resonance, and from the Lattices of understanding crafted within one's True Source.
His existence buzzed as he continued to receive more information.
|After 3 Existential Dimensional Lattices are formed and perfected from a True Source, a connection to one of the 10 Archetypal Truths of Existence would be drawn and they would gain a Resistance.|
Resistance.
Resistance not to an attack.
Not to pain.
But to the very nature of all True Sources in that category of Resistance.
Where normal beings perished at the touch of a True Source of Fire...those with a certain True Absolute Existential Resistance would not even burn.
Where timelines collapsed at the whisper of Chronos, those with a certain True Absolute Existential Resistance would remain.
True Absolute Existential Resistances.
Noah's weavings burned brightly as his Third Existential Dimensional Lattice gave him all the information regarding them!
|Records of 10 True Absolute Existential Resistances are being received and quantified as follows.|
Paradoxical Resistance| :: Resistance against collapsing contradictions and paradoxical True Sources. (Examples: Paradox, Chaos, Collapse, Fold, Uncertainty...)
Temporal Resistance| :: Resistance against Time-based True Sources and Timeline Interference. (Examples: Time, Chrono, Continuum, Moment...)
Elemental Resistance| :: Resistance against fundamental True Sources of classical elements. (Examples: Fire, Ice, Earth, Wind, Water...)
Conceptual Resistance| :: Resistance against existential concepts turned True Sources. (Examples: Death, Love, Pride, Sloth, Wrath...)
Spiritual Resistance| :: Resistance to True Sources stemming from the abstract. (Examples: Soul, Spirit, Faith...)
Dimensional Resistance| :: Resistance to distortions across Dimensions and Spatial Manipulation. (Examples: Void, Space, Multiversal Collapse...)
Origin Resistance| :: Resistance to ancestral, primal, or fundamental Origin-based True Sources. (Examples: Genesis, Beginning, Ending, Prime...)
Quantum Resistance| :: Resistance to probability, and fluctuating-state True Sources. (Examples: Quantum, Probability, Superposition...)
Emotive Resistance| :: Resistance to True Sources relating to emotional manipulation, madness, despair, and inner collapse. (Examples: Despair, Madness, Fear, Euphoria)
Linguistic / Law Resistance| :: Resistance to Law, Commandment, and True Name-based Sources. (Examples: Law, Order, Oath, Word...)
The overflow of information was heavy.
And there was still more!
|After 3 Lattices successfully formed within a Primarch's being, 1% Resistance may manifest with the Primarch's Source.|
[You have gained: Paradoxical Resistance +1%.] [Current Lattices Formed: 3.] [Threshold to Next gain of an Unknown Percentage Paradoxical Resistance: 9, 81, 729, 6561, 59,049 Lattices....]
Information filled him in abundance!
About Resistances.
And they were unlike any of the previous mechanics of Resistances he previously knew.
The information of how they worked was made abundantly clear to him!
If for example, someone had 1% Resistance, it did not mean they could Resist 1% damage.
That if someone lesser who did not have a single Lattice of any type dealt damage and it was assigned a Damage Value of 100, only 99 Damage Values go through.
No.
With the wonder of Primarchs of Complexity and Purity and Existential Dimensional Lattices, it meant that out of the 100 Damage Values, not even a single one would pass through!
True Absolute Existential Resistance worked closely connected to Existential Dimensional Lattices as having even 1% Resistance alone put Primarchs above everyone else below them.

The way they could affect true sources, or the damage value, was profoundly elevated with Existential Dimensional Lattices as it put them on another realm of power entirely in how they could distort existance!
So 1% True Absolute Existential Paradoxical Resistance did not mean if a Resplendent Monad had attacked Noah, Noah would be able to resist 1% damage.
He would be able to resist all the damage!
It was hard and simple to grasp at the same time as there were many variables in place as well!
The rain of True Source Tears of Existence still fell- each drop its own miracle, its own impossible essence.
Noah stood beneath it all, motionless, like a statue carved from blue and gold tyranny.
Yet inside him, change bloomed like fire.
He had unlocked the foundation.
Three Existential Dimensional Lattices now pulsed within him as what was complex became easy to understand.
He looked at the blinking wonder of Paradoxical Resistance.
[True Absolute Existential Resistance: Paradoxical Resistance +1%]
The implications were enormous.
Not just for power.
But for survival.
Noah's thoughts ran like lightning, condensing as he tried to truly grasp the principle behind these newly received revelations.
What did Resistance really mean?
He closed his eyes.
And imagined.
A being with a single True Source: Fire.
They unleashed their most refined technique against an opponent who had no Existential Dimensional Lattices.
Their Purity Quotient and Complexity Quotient surged, blazing a river of destruction...
100 points of damage.
Or rather- 100 points of influence onto the enemy's True Source.
And it worked.
It ravaged.
It burned.
Now, imagine the same being attacking someone who had formed 3 Lattices.
Just 3 Existential Dimensional Lattices.
Not even about numbers.
But that resonance—the harmonic simplicity those Lattices expressed enabled that defender to form 1% True Absolute Existential Resistance.
One percent.
And now?
None of those 100 points of True Source influence landed.
Not one.
Because True Absolute Existential Resistance didn't operate by subtraction.
It operated by denial.
It didn't say "You take less damage."
It said "You do not get to affect me."!
Noah breathed slowly.
The complexity now made simple.
True Absolute Existential Resistance was immunity to the alteration of your weavings.
And the higher it grew...
The more unchangeable your True Source became.
That... that was how Primarchs with high Resistance became untouchable.
If one had 10% Resistance?
It would take an entity with at least 10% matching Resistance and a number of Lattices formed beyond measure to even qualify to alter their weavings fully.
But there were 10 different Resistances.
How did interactions between them work?!
HUUM!
Noah's weavings buzzed.
And then...
A whisper of understanding brushed his mind like the edge of a forgotten truth.
Another epiphany- brought by his current Existential Dimensional Lattices!
He saw it.
Not in combat.
Not in theory.
But in possibility.
He closed his eyes and imagined.
Two figures flickered within the vision his mind constructed- Primarchs, theoretical yet real, formed by the principles of Resistance he was now grasping.
One, surrounded by the delicate geometry of spinning clockwork- a wielder of Time.
His Temporal Resistance shone like glass fractals catching sunlight.
Another, breathing in waves of translucent soul-flame, a Primarch of Spirit.
She bore the weight of Spiritual Resistance, humming with the frequency of the inner Self.
And when they clashed?
Time met Spirit.
And Noah understood.
Even though Temporal Resistance denied any attempt to unravel the threads of Time- halting rewrites, freezing loops, denying regressions, it did not render the soul immune.
The Spiritual Primarch's strike landed.
Not perfectly.
Not deeply.
But it landed.
Because Temporal Resistance did not defend against Spirit.
It resisted temporal edits of the Self, but not a puncture of the soul.
And vice versa- when the Primarch of Spirit was struck by a wave of temporal collapse meant to regress her essence?
Her Spiritual Resistance pushed back.
Not completely.
But enough.
Noah's eyes widened.
"Resistances are focused," he murmured, "but they aren't absolute walls.
They're directional weavings of protection.
When mismatched... effects bleed through.
Diminished.
Filtered.
But not nullified."
He could see it now- Primarchs wielding unmatched Resistances against others.
A Primarch of Death clashing with one of Space.
A Primarch of Fire attacking one of Madness.
Their Resistances mattered.
But not equally.
It depended on how closely their domains aligned.
On how many Lattices had formed.
On how deeply each Primarch had carved clarity into their truth.
It wasn't only immunity.
It was also matching and anchoring.
And the stronger the anchor, and a heavy a mismatch?
The harder it was to be rewritten.
Noah exhaled softly, the lattice within him thrumming with growing light, his eyes spinning with Wheels of Tyranny!
"I need more," he whispered.
"More lattices.
From...ALL True Sources!"
Yes.
Others...had a single True Source.
Noah had multiple as he...could potentially gain all 10 Resistances!

chapters.title: Chapter 3754: Resistance III
paragraphs: Noah gazed out into the wonder of the Infiniverse Crucible after obtaining such a grand achievement.
Paradoxical Resistance.
He could do more.
He wanted to do more.
But at this same time, as his stage of power became that of a Primarch of Complexity and Purity through his Lineage, other parts of him and their True Sources...were also pulled up tremendously!
To the extent that something was triggered amidst all of this.
Noah felt his existence buzz as prompts bloomed...alongside a fundamental, tremendous change of how...he saw everything.
|The True Source of Fables joins Cheats, Plot, Infinity, Quintessence, Tyranny, Paradox, and the Protagonist as part of your weavings approaching the Primarchy of Complexity and Purity.|
|Limited Fictional Transcendence has jumped a major milestone.|
|Absolute Fictional Transcendence has been obtained.|
HUUUM!
His weavings buzzed.
Something changed!
He blinked at the unique sensation and oddity as another prompt flashed before him.
|As the Protagonist, your Fable is infinite if you so choose. Under Absolute Fictional Transcendence, your Fable is yours to tell. First Person View Point has been unlocked.|
His Fable...was his to tell?
He was...
He was?
No. Not he.
I.
I was.
HUUM!
The change became ever so real as Noah looked around, as if he could see existence itself being rewritte-
"Hold on. Thats not right...it is...my Fable to tell. Through my eyes."
A moment of silence.
And after this moment, the change settled.
The Fable went back to a previous sentance!
The change became ever so real as...I looked around, as if I could see existence itself being rewritten!
WAA!
"WAA? What Waa? Take a breather for a moment. I will continue my own Fable, under my own terms."
Silence.
Peace.
No other influence pressed down.
In a moment of profound oddity, it felt like I spoke to myself about how I viewed existence and its wonders.
In discussing it.
In narrating it.
This was my Fable.
So it would not be He.
But I.
And I could tell it more Quintessentially and Tyrannical than anyone ever could.
So, lets do this properly, shall we?
Rain fell.
An existential irony, really.
The Crucible wept with beauty. Existence shed tears from above as if it finally realized the weight of its own creation.
Multicolored droplets cascaded from the Infiniverse Forge, each one a sobbing whisper of a Source.
The others- oh, how they reached. Arms raised. Eyes wide. Reverence or desperation for more Complexity and Purity; I never could tell the difference in those seeking miracles.
But I?
I stood still.
A calm tyrant amid shrieking joy. Rain did not grace me. It bent. Flowed past. Avoided.
It knew better. It knew that I did not need it.
So it continued to be a backdrop as after the chnage in how my Fable unfolded, I looked back within my own existence.
Three Existential Dimensional Lattices spun within me. They hummed softly. One might call it music. I called it inevitability.
Origin Prime Osmontian Infinitum. A mouthful of a name.
A destiny. A curse of wonders and apocalypses.. infinitely. It was a Quintessential foundation, jagged and magnificent.
And yet, it wasn't enough.
Because power, like truth, is a staircase. And I? I don't believe in ceilings.
I believed in infinity.
The Crucible rumbled, ever so dramatic.
And then...she spoke. My long time construct and friend.
|You understand.| said the Infiniverse.
Her voice laced through my thoughts like a lattice folding into itself. Gentle. Absolute. Respectful as always.
|It was hard to explain when I reached it as you truly have to be there understand. To truly understand Primarchy, you have to be a Primarch.|
Her voice was filled with that same calm and gentle authority.
I opened my eyes.
And I saw the overaching Infiniverse...and her budding Living Wheel with all its Spokes flash all at once.

|Even though your other True Sources have not reached Primarchy,| she continued, |you should be able to begin forming Lattices through mine as what is mine..is yours. Everything is catching up rather rapidly and flowing in the same direction.|
Direction.
Hah.
I've always known where I'm going.
I stared at the sky. At the infinity symbol turning like celestial judgment.
"Then show me."
Power did not gather.
It unraveled and became clear before me.
Before me stretched weavings of unbearable scopes of wonder- of True Sources I could choose from to form Existential Dimensional Lattices apart from my own Lineage.
For no other purpose that obtaining all Resistances!
Entropy. Dreams. Manadynamics. Continuity. Fire. Space. Soul. Genesis. Quantum. Time. Death. Wrath. Sloth. Nuclear Force. Uncertainty. Providence. Relativity. Mirror...
They all glimmered brightly with possibility.
Tempting.
I simply needed nine more. Nine Lattices from nine distinct True Sources.
To do what no other had done...right? It would be a wonder if another entity was able to do the same thing.
To obtain every one of the Ten True Absolute Existential Resistances.
So I began.
Not with haste. With decision.
"Let the first be the True Source of the Singed. Fire. My beginning."
Flames.
A true beginning as it all stemmed from a single fireball.
Flames danced behind my spine and erupted all around. Not wild. Not free. Disciplined.
Gloriously crimson gold as they could burn anything.
Fire was not rage.
Fire was decision.
One lattice. Two. Three.
Each one looked like interwoven lines of geometric wonders that formed into dimensional infinity symbols that layered unto each other with terrific geometry!
And the end result was a glorious one.
| You have gained: True Absolute Existential Elemental Resistance +1%.|
My existence buzzed as it welcomed another Resistance.
And the sound it made...did not need to be changed.
HUUM!
A magisterial buzzing of Existence echoed out.
A ring of flame anchored into my essence. Fire would burn others. It would obey me.
My eyes moved on towards the third as while multicolored rain continued to flow all around me, I called out again.
"Chronos."
Something fitting for the enemies I currently faced who played with time.
Purple brilliance erupted around me.
I touched time. Not as a river. As a structure.
Sequence. Cause. Result.
Tick. Tick. Tock!
One lattice after another formed as the design of the first three Lattices of any Source were easy enough with Complexity Quotient and Purity Quotient of even just 100,000.
I knew that it would be getting exponentially harder to form more over time as...of course it would be like that.
But three Existential Dimensional Lattices of Chronos that looked like complex purple infinity symbols danced around me.
| You have gained: True Absolute Existential Temporal Resistance +1%.|
My being solidified further. Anchored in its own river of time. Time would remember me, but not alter me.
I continued ahead without delay as even though I was stretching out an instant of my being into what seemed seconds and minutes, time would still move in that Dead Wheel of Existence soon enough.
So...
"Genesis."
I called out to another Source that was more advanced under the banner of the Infiniverse.
Genesis!
Creation wasn't just about beginning. It was about becoming.
The first lattice was potential. The second, breath. The third, defiance.
And soon after...
| You have gained: True Absolute Existential Origin Resistance +1%.|
Now, even creation must ask permission.
Next up was...
"Quantum."
BZZT!
Complexity broke down to simplicity.
Lattices spun and collapsed in probabilities and existence at its most fundamental level.
| You have gained: True Absolute Existential Quantum Resistance +1%.|
"Space."
I called out once more as...Space expanded, and I compressed it right after.
Three lattices, each one a mockery of distance formed.
| You have gained: True Absolute Existential Dimensional Resistance +1%.|
Location became preference for me as even through the folds, I should be able to move much faster!
"Soul"
I kept things rolling and moved on to the Soul.
The Self. Not the mind or the origin. Not the body.
Essence.
I touched it. Let it hum.
Three notes played in sequence as my weavings of existence resonated, and three Lattices bloomed.
| You have gained: True Absolute Existential Spiritual Resistance +1%.|
Untouchable in spirit was gradually becoming a reality.
"Infinity."
WUU!
What else could be said about this?
My pathway.
My Fable.
My being.

Three Lattices quickly formed with a gorgeous blue radiance as Infinity...could actually fit as something thst granted Paradoxical Resistance due to its nature, but I called upon it now because it was also...a concept.
| You have gained: True Absolute Existential Conceptual Resistance +1%.|
Concepts and ideas...they would not kill me. They would beg me before they could even injure me.
And then came...
"Uncertainty."
Another Pillar of the Infiniverse that made up its foundation as it fit into the Paradoxical Resistance, but Uncertainty was also an emotion, was it not?
Three dazzling murky crimson Lattices rapidly formed and spun around me.
| You have gained: True Absolute Existential Emotive Resistance +1%.|
I was not immune to uncertainty. But I could learn to own it.
Lastly...there was something so closely connected to my Lineage that had reached Primarchy that even without the help of the Infiniverse...
"Veritarch."
HUUM!
I called out to something that completed my Living Wheel of Existence.
My Atlas.
And it spun tyrannically at the center of my being as my own Lineage supplied it, and the Truthborne Continuum began to bloom its own Existential Dimensional Lattices!
Law. Word. Truth.
Scripture etched in threads. Three declarations, and...
| You have gained: True Absolute Existential Law Resistance +1%.|
Around me, Quintessential waves of Existential Dimensional Lattices spun.
And they were...30 in total.
Three from 10 different Sources leading to 10 Archetypal Truths- 10 True Absolute Existential Resistances!

chapters.title: Chapter 3755: Resistances IV
paragraphs: And then it came.
As 30 Existential Dimensional Lattices spun all around me, a prompt came as if to affirm my being.
| You have unlocked all 10 True Absolute Existential Resistances at 1%. You may be the first in all of recorded Existence to do so, giving you an exalted distinction.|
Exalted?
No.
Not exalted. But heading towards Infinity.
A being no longer playing within the rules.
One ready... to change them!
The rain continued in the Infiniverse Crucible. Still radiant. Still multicolored. Still beneath me.
But my eyes had already left it behind.
They were fixed elsewhere- away from the Infiniverse entirely! Through the eyes of another body.
Time slowed.
Nine Time Sentinels. Wrapped in yesterdays they couldn't let go.
I'd seen them before and their status panels, but things should be distinctly different now.
In addition to their Complexity Quotients and Purity Quotients, I should now be able to see something else.
NAME: Time Sentinel Paraxis
TITLE: Librarian of Lost Moments
TRUE SOURCE: Regression
RESISTANCE: Temporal Resistance (3%)
Too little!
My eyes wandered.
NAME: Time Sentinel Virunys
TITLE: Recorder of Eternal Now
TRUE SOURCE: Moment
RESISTANCE: Temporal Resistance (5%) |
Powerful. But...still not over the top.
And then...
NAME: Time Sentinel Leader Velmior Thal-Veyr TITLE: Grand Conductor of the Whenfolds
TRUE SOURCE: Interval
RESISTANCE: Temporal Resistance (9%)
The most powerful Time Sentinel.
How many Existential Dimensional Lattices did he fold to attain 9%? A number that seemed low, but its capabilities were undoubtedly grand!
That was what near-untouchability looked like. Almost sacred. Almost.
And then I looked to my left.
Romulus.
NAME: Primarch Romulus, Verdant Flame of Collapse
TITLE: Primarch of Entropic Continuity
TRUE SOURCE: Entropy
RESISTANCE: Paradoxical Resistance (10%)
Less Complexity Quotient and Purity Quotient, and yet...1% more!
Romulus was a Marked One who had his weavings Compressed, while the Time Sentinels were not.
Romulus was a reason to be calm in this whole ordeal even if I didn't erupt with my newfound power.
I may or may not be able to touch him in his current stage.
He had after all, trained for countless millions of years while I...how many days has it been since grasping True Sources?
But even I had limits. Temporary ones.
Romulus stood like a collapsed temple of inevitability.
I smiled while looking at this being who was my senior from the same Wheel of Existence.
Not envy.
But a sense of admiration.
A monsters acknowledging another monster.
After all, his True Source of Entropy led him to the strongest Resistance- or what I personally believed to be the strongest Resistance- Paradoxical.
As for the Sentinels?
One Resistance for all of these entities from the Chronosect of Threadbound Folds.
I had ten Resistances. At one percent each. So, how would a clash unfold?
I closed my eyes.
And Existence paused.
I could feel every terrifying possible weaving about to erupt at this moment.
I felt Velmior watching. Judging.
I felt Romulus ready to move against Eluriah Veilnox.
I saw the Time Sentinels and their confidence.
They thought they understood time, and that they understood me.
They would soon come to learn otherwise!
BOOM!
I opened my eyes.
'You see through one lens,' I thought. 'While I see through ten.'
No rain fell in this Dead Frequency of the End.
The Dead Wheel it was on groaned beneath us.
The Frequency of the End pulsed, barely living, barely breathing- a collapsed monument buried in its own myth.
Nine Time Sentinels stood across the fractured horizon. Each a master of twisted seconds and rewoven instants, their robes fluttering in warped winds that had no direction.
But only one mattered.
Velmior Thal-Veyr.
Grand Conductor of the Whenfolds. A man who had apparently seen every end of every story and simply... yawned.
I stood between him and Romulus.
I had already measured them all.
But I needed to know more and obtain additional data to back how my weavings were unfolding.
I believed in seeing.
In knowing.
And so, I stepped forward.
Voice low. Unmoved.
"Instead of erupting into a chaotic battlefield where a thousand clashes lead to the same end already read a million times," I said, "why don't we propose something simpler?"
Velmior's ageless eyes turned toward me, curiosity flickering like a dying clock.
I tilted my head, gaze sharp. "Let the strongest of each side fight. The rest will observe."
Murmurs stirred across the dead weavings. Even the wind tilted in question.
Velmior's lips parted in what might have been called a smile.
Romulus didn't move, but I saw the corner of his robe ripple- he was not amused.
I continued, calm and absolute. "If all outcomes are already known, then there's no need to waste energy on repetition."
That was the trick.
He had already seen all futures where we fought as a whole.
But had he seen this?
Did his infinite echoes cover a variable he didn't predict?
Velmior chuckled.
A low, resonant sound. Not laughter. Appreciation.
"You wish to watch the truly powerful dance," he said. "To see if the fabric of time can be folded differently."
He raised his hand. Time folded around his fingertips like a child's toy- the one around him anyways.
"No one interferes," he said.
His voice was not loud.
But the other Sentinels froze and gave an affirmation.
All of them.
Not a breath moved. Not a strand of power shifted. Every timeline paused.
Even Eluriah's gaze stiffened slightly.
"I will indulge this," Velmior said, walking forward, each step grinding eons into the air.
"And in doing so, show you all... that resistance, even refined, even entropic, is still- futile."
His cloak of moments flared.
Romulus stepped beside me, not glancing my way.
His entropy roared.
Their eyes locked.
Existence trembled.
And above, the Dead Wheel began to whisper!
BOOOM!
The air fractured.
It didn't break. It didn't shatter.
It folded.
Temporal pressure and paradoxical entropy collapsed against each other as the two stepped forward- not like men, but like movements.

Romulus, Verdant Flame of Collapse, bore down like the slow end of all things. His every breath exhaled centuries. His robes didn't ripple in the wind; the wind adjusted its course to avoid disturbing them. Behind him, Existential Dimensional Lattices bloomed. Not three. Not ten. But dozens upon dozens as they should be in the hundreds, or more if he was still holding back.
Each one a geometric prayer written in the collapsing bones of dying chaos.
They spun with violence and entropy, fractal and furious. Each lattice a decree of Paradoxical Resistance made manifest.
And across from him, Velmior Thal-Veyr, Grand Conductor of the Whenfolds, did not yield.

He stood at the nexus of a storm of time. His body did not move- but his echoes did. Countless iterations of himself flickered like spiraling clock hands around him. Some young. Some aged. Some already dead. Some still being born.
His Lattices? Different.
Elegant. Simple. Singular.
They did not roar.
They ticked.
And each tick was a commandment.
I watched as the first clash occurred. It did not begin with motion. It began with presence. When two inevitabilities occupy the same point in space, Existence is forced to make a decision.
Reality blinked.
Time jumped.
Entropy bled.
Romulus struck first.
No war cry. No grand gesture. Just a ripple.
One of his Lattices flared, and the ground behind Velmior aged chaotically a thousand years in an instant. Dead Omniverses that had once stood there in a forgotten timeline turned to sand and ash
Velmior raised a single finger.
And rewound it.
His Temporal Resistance pulsed- not defensive, but corrective. Reality itself hiccuped as the aged sands reformed, recoiled, returned.
But only mostly.
Romulus smiled.
Because a third of the decay remained.
...Interesting.
One percent.
Just one.
It was all it took.
Even among Primarchs.
I stood at the edge of it all, untouched, my hands folded behind my back as I observed the clash of titans.
The difference in power wasn't in force. It was in finality. Romulus moved as if the outcome had already been etched. Velmior moved as if it could still be negotiated.
And therein was the difference.
Certainty.
That 1% difference between them made one of them certain!
Velmior narrowed his eyes.
Time screamed.
Dozens of versions of himself collapsed into the now, each one wielding a moment from a separate timeline. Together, they moved in synchronicity to box Romulus in.
Romulus's entropy expanded.
Not violently. Inevitably.
His Lattices burned downward like chains of collapsing logic. Every strike from Velmior aged into irrelevance. Every breath he took aged the air around him. His very act of being eroded timelines.
And then...
He moved.
Not forward.
Not backward.
He slipped.
A paradox.
One moment he was clashing with Velmior.
The next, he slipped and he stood before Eluriah Veilnox!
It was not teleportation.
It was not speed.
It was priority.
Romulus did not ignore the timeline.
He rearranged it.
He never agreen to simply fight the strongest as he moved with his own rhythm!
Velmior turned, but too late.
Romulus lifted a single hand, and twenty-five of his Lattices screamed downward like falling thrones.
Entropy landed.
Eluriah gasped and roared.
Her Temporal Resistance kicked in- but it wasn't enough.
She staggered. Blood, real and heavy, painted the air.
The Sentinels moved.
Every one of them.
Even those who had sworn to stay still.
Even those who believed in observation roared.
They surged forward.
But Romulus was already there.
His robes burned. Not with fire. With endings.
He didn't speak. He didn't gloat.
He simply withstood.
Time twisted. Timeline after timeline attempted to overwrite his presence, to bend him to a rewritten outcome.
He denied all of them.
Because Paradoxical Resistance didn't protect him from harm.
It made him inharmonious.
Untouchable.
And from the center of it all, he stood as ten Sentinels unleashed a weaving of overlapping seconds, recursions, and never-was moments.
He held them all back.
Because of one thing.
Because of one percent!
It was glorious to see.
I folded my arms tighter.
So this... is the value of resistance.
Ten percent Paradoxical, against nine percent Temporal.
That one percent made Romulus immune to the correction. Immune to the edits. To the will of timelines.
He existed in a place Velmior could not reach.
He was... certain.
While Velmior was still trying to be.
And that made all the difference.
The war had begun.
But I had remained still!
Because I wasn't done watching.
Because I hadn't yet seen enough.
BOOM!
Existence fractured.
Not metaphorically. Not conceptually. It fractured.
Cracks of paradox bled through the very breath of the Dead Wheel as Primarch Romulus surged with terrifying defiance against the Grand Conductor of the Whenfolds.
They were both titans of foundation. But the difference between nine and ten... was not a number. It was a truth.
And I saw it clearly.

As the Time Sentinel Leader's Lattices of flowing Interval bloomed like an ocean of collapsing hours, Romulus answered with entropy given voice. He moved like the end of all things, his body sheathed in spiraling lattices that disassembled the very idea of continuity.
Their clash sent out tremors across time. Past. Present. Future. Everything shook.
It wasn't just power.
It was ideology. One sought to preserve. The other? Collapse.
And then came the roar.
"Entropic Lattice Fracture."
Romulus' voice thundered with a timbre that could end decades.
He sacrificed them. Dozens. Lattices he had formed across eons shattered.
Each one a monumental act of destruction.
Of entropy!

They cracked like glass and then exploded, each detonation rippling with Complexity and Purity compressed into a singular catastrophic burst. The Dead Prime Frequency of the End howled and cried in reply. Even Velmior stepped back.
And Romulus moved.
He tore through the remaining Time Sentinels- not to kill, but to pass. Each step was a paradox made solid. Each breath carried the weight of ending moments.
And then he appeared before her running visage.
Primarch Eluriah Veilnox.
Her terror had not yet faded.
She tried to speak.
But her words fell into the entropy. Time itself frayed. Threads that made up her lifespan withered. Youth, age, power- consumed by collapse. Her body shimmered in a kaleidoscope of decaying futures.
"NO!" Velmior bellowed. The first crack in his composure.
The Chronosect stirred in fury. And they moved.
All of them.
Their time weavings snapped like whips. But Romulus stood at the center, the embodiment of 10% Paradoxical Resistance, denying their alteration attempts as if they were insects striking stone.
It was beautiful.
And I chose that moment to move.
Because timing, you see... is not something you follow.
It's something you impose.
I appeared behind the weakest of them that was rushing.
Time Sentinel Paraxis, the Librarian of Lost Moments.
Regression as his True Source.
A fragile idea. Dangerous, yes- but also backward. Unsuitable against a tyrant that only moves forward.
I did not draw power wildly. I did not reveal all.
Just three.
Three Existential Dimensional Lattices from my Origin Prime Osmontian Infinitum Lineage.
They hummed. Just three, and already, Paraxis trembled from the ambush.
He turned.
I looked him in the eye.
And then unraveled the river of time surrounding him. Not by clashing with it. But by rewriting what the river meant.
My weavings bled into his.
And his existence began to come undone.
Not violently. Precisely. Like threads pulled from a weaving.
He screamed, but not from pain.
From understanding.
He knew what was happening.
His True Source began to dissolve, and my weavings did what they were meant to do.
They took.
| The True Source of Loot has been ignited.|
WUU!
Golden-purple sigils erupted around me as the very death of this Time Sentinel became... mine.

His Lattices collapsed, and rather than fade, they folded into golden boxes of geometric compression. Dozens of Lattices transformed into cascading fragments that gathered before me like treasure chests forged of fallen existence.
The clash of titans above the shattered expanse of the Dead Wheel roared with apocalyptic resonance.
Below, I stood.
Still. Quiet. Thinking.
The severed corpse of the Time Sentinel I'd dismantled still lingered in fading echoes, his timeline unraveling like a poorly threaded script. And before me, something glorious began to manifest.
| Paradoxical Primarch Loot Cache Constructed. |
Ah.
So this was it.
The True Source of Loot bloomed within me like a second heart- one that beat with theft, inheritance, and sovereign reclamation.
Ribbons of brilliance unfolded in front of me as the Cache assembled: glowing orbs spiraling, lines of code-like lattice rotating around a central point.
| Contents: 1 Undefined Existential Dimensional Lattice (x4) | 1 True Source Sigil (Regression) |
Oh, Regression.
How poetic.
The very Source they used to claw backward through time now rested as fragmented essence in my grasp. I lifted a hand. The Cache responded.
Threads pulled into my body and gave understanding.
Undefined Lattices:- not yet formed, not yet decided. Their only law was mine. Their only purpose was adaptation.
They spun into the center of my Loot Source, a gravitational paradox pulling them close.
And like stars being devoured by a conceptual black hole, the Undefined Lattices began to shape.
| Initiating Lattice Formation: True Source of Loot |
| Lattice One Formed.| | Lattice Two Formed.| | Lattice Three Formed. |
HUUM!
The entire Dead Wheel shook beneath the formation.
The Lattices of Loot weren't just structures.
These were teeth.
A system designed to take. To rip. To consume.
Not from cruelty.
But from earned dominance.
I blinked. My eyes turned toward the next Sentinel.
Time Sentinel Vyronn, Herald of Punctuality. A Primarch-level Time Warden. 150,000 CQ. 165,000 PQ. Temporal Resistance: 4%.
"Let's test something," I murmured, stepping forward.
My Existential Dimensional Lattices responded. Not three this time.
All of them.
More than Thirty now with the Lattices of Loot being formed.
I glanced at the Resistance that hung like accolades as I moved.
| Elemental: 1%, Temporal: 1%, Origin: 1%, Quantum: 1%, Dimensional: 1%, Spiritual: 1%, Conceptual: 1%, Law: 1%, Emotive: 1%, Paradoxical: 1% |
All moved at once.
My body glowed with tyrannical clarity.

I appeared behind Vyronn in an instant. Not because I was fast, but because resistance to spatial restriction now made space an accessory, even with the singular low percentage I had as relative to my enemy that did not have even this 1% Dimensional Resistances...I was above.
The moment I touched his shoulder, it began.
My Lattices folded over his own like sharpened ink.
He turned, mouth opening to call upon the Whenfolds...but his voice did not come.
His words unraveled. Conceptual Resistance.
His position warped. Dimensional Resistance.
His True Source rippled. Temporal Resistance.
His heart despaired. Emotive Resistance.
And then I struck.
With a single downward motion of my hand, I pressed more than thirty Lattices of my own against the few dozen of his I could detect.
Almost evenly matched.
But not even close.
He began to tear.
Not his flesh.
His continuity.
HUUM!
Another Cache began to form.
As he screamed, Time fractured around us- but my tenfold Resistance matrix held the distortion outside my frame.
| Constructing New Paradoxical Primarch Loot Cache. |
His Lattices collapsed one by one.
His Sigil of Punctuality cracked.
| Acquired: Undefined Existential Dimensional Lattices (x7) | True Source Sigil: Punctuality |
I let the Cache float toward me. Consuming it with a single breath.
The Loot Source roared, trying to use these Undefined Lattices for itself as I stopped it, directing them to be used to form Lattices of my Lineage.
At 9 Lattices in a single True Source, one's Resistance related to that True Source would increase by an unknown percentage.
The next one after that was 81.
I would soon see what 9 Lattices of my Lineage would give.
Then my gaze turned.
The Time Sentinel Leader stared at me now. Eyes no longer lazy, no longer smug. His gaze had changed to that of rage.
I returned it, expression calm, words precise.
"I bet you didn't see that in all your timelines."
The Dead Wheel howled.
And I smiled.
Because this wasn't about stealing victories.
It was about rewriting fate.
One Cache at a time!
